corpus_topic: Smart home device pairing and room assignment flow
query_text: Make a smart home setup app for my phone where I can pair new devices one by one and then assign each one to a specific room in my place, like bedroom or kitchen, so everything ends up organized and I can actually find which device is where without digging through a messy list.
query_text_zh: 做一个智能家居管理应用，我可以逐个配对新设备，然后把每个设备分配到特定房间，比如卧室或厨房，这样所有设备就能整理好，我也能一目了然地知道哪个设备在哪个房间，不用再翻一大堆乱七八糟的列表。

corpus_topic: Subscription content source add with frequency preference
query_text: Create a subscription manager app for mobile where I can add new content sources, like newsletters or blogs, and for each one pick how often I want updates, daily, weekly, or monthly, so I can keep track of what I follow and make sure I'm only getting things at the pace that works for me.
query_text_zh: 开发一个订阅管理应用，我可以添加新的内容源，像是邮件通讯或博客，然后为每一个设置更新频率，是每天、每周还是每月，这样我就能管理好我关注的内容，确保只会以适合我的速度收到信息。

corpus_topic: Forum discussion thread starter with category tagging
query_text: Make a forum app for my phone where I can start a new discussion thread, write out what I want to talk about, and pick one or more topic categories to attach to it so other people can find it easily, with the category list right there on the same screen when I'm writing.
query_text_zh: 做一个论坛应用，我可以发起新的讨论主题，写下想要讨论的内容，然后给它添加一个或多个话题分类，这样其他人就能容易地找到它，而且分类列表就在我写东西的同一个屏幕上。

corpus_topic: Community event with ticketing and capacity limit
query_text: Need a community event planner app for mobile where organizers can set up an event with a title, date, and a set number of spots available, then people can grab a ticket right there in the app, and once all the spots fill up the registration closes on its own so nobody oversigns.
query_text_zh: 需要一个社区活动规划应用，组织者可以创建活动，填写标题、日期和可用名额，然后人们可以直接在应用里抢票，一旦名额满了系统就会自动关闭报名，防止过度报名。

corpus_topic: Language deck creation with spaced-repetition schedule
query_text: Need a language flashcard app for my phone where I can build a new vocabulary deck by adding words and their meanings one at a time, and the app keeps a review schedule that spaces out when each card comes back so I'm practicing things right before I'd normally forget them.
query_text_zh: 需要一个语言闪卡学习应用，我可以建立新的词汇卡组，逐个添加单词和意思，应用会自动安排复习时间，在我可能忘记前展现这些卡片，帮我高效复习。

corpus_topic: Investment watchlist ticker add with price alert
query_text: Build a stock tracker app for mobile where I can add tickers to a personal watchlist and for each one set a price level I care about, so the app shows me a clear alert on that stock's entry whenever the price hits the number I picked, keeping everything in one easy place.
query_text_zh: 做一个股票追踪应用，我可以把个股代码添加到自己的监控清单，并为每只股票设置一个我关心的价格水平，这样当股价触及我设定的数字时应用就会向我发警报，所有信息都在一个方便的地方。

corpus_topic: HR leave request with document and coverage attach
query_text: A leave request tool for the phone where an employee can fill in the dates, pick the leave type, attach any supporting paperwork like a doctor's note or approval letter, and also add the name of whoever is covering their work while they're out, all in one clean flow before submitting.
query_text_zh: 做一个请假工具应用，员工可以填入日期、选择假期类型、上传医疗证明或批准信等相关文件，还能写上代理人的名字，所有内容都在一个流畅的界面里完成后再提交。

corpus_topic: Insurance claim with photo evidence upload
query_text: Build a mobile insurance claim app where I can start a new claim by filling in what happened, then snap and upload photos of the damage straight from my phone camera as evidence, with each photo showing a small thumbnail so I can confirm I attached the right ones before I hit submit.
query_text_zh: 做一个保险理赔应用，我可以填写事故描述来创建新的理赔，然后直接用手机摄像头拍摄损伤照片并上传作为证据，每张照片都会显示缩略图让我确认附件都对了再提交。

corpus_topic: Property inspection checklist with severity scoring
query_text: Build a property inspection app for mobile where I can go through a checklist of things to check in a unit, and for each item I can mark how bad the issue is on a simple scale from minor to serious, so at the end I get a quick summary showing which problems need urgent attention.
query_text_zh: 做一个房产检查应用，我可以逐项检查某个单元里的所有事项，对于每一项我都能用简单的等级标记问题的严重程度，从轻微到严重，最后能得到一份总结，清楚地告诉我哪些问题需要立即处理。

corpus_topic: Grant application new submission with file attach
query_text: Create a grant application tool for my phone where I can start a new submission by filling in the project name, description, and requested amount, then attach any supporting files like a budget sheet or proposal doc, so the whole thing is ready to send without needing to jump between different apps.
query_text_zh: 做一个拨款申请工具，我可以填写项目名称、描述和申请金额来创建新申请，然后上传预算表或提案文档等文件，这样整个申请就准备好了，不用在不同应用之间来回切换。

corpus_topic: Class schedule edit with room and instructor conflict alert
query_text: Create a class schedule manager app for my phone so I can go in and change a class time or swap the room it meets in, and if that change creates a clash, like the same instructor or same room booked twice, the app flags it right away so I can fix it before saving and avoid the headache later.
query_text_zh: 做一个课程表管理应用，我可以进去修改某门课的时间或教室，如果这个改动导致冲突，比如同一个教师或同一个教室被重复预订了，应用会立即标记出来让我修正，省得后续出麻烦。

corpus_topic: Routine condition edit with impact summary before save
query_text: Build a routine manager app for mobile where I can edit the conditions of any automated routine I have set up, and before I actually save the changes the app shows me a plain summary of what else will be affected, so I know upfront if tweaking one thing breaks something else I depend on.
query_text_zh: 做一个自动化流程管理应用，我可以编辑任何设置好的自动化流程的条件，在真正保存改动前应用会显示一个清晰的总结，让我提前知道这个修改会影响其他什么东西，防止我的改动破坏掉其他依赖的东西。

corpus_topic: Multi-step checkout delivery address and payment edit
query_text: Create a checkout flow app for my phone where I can move through each step separately, updating my delivery address on one screen and then switching my payment method on the next, so I can fix whatever needs changing without having to redo the whole order from scratch every single time.
query_text_zh: 做一个多步骤结账流程应用，我可以独立地逐步完成，在一个屏幕上更新收货地址，然后在下一个屏幕上切换支付方式，这样需要改什么就改什么，不用每次都从头开始重新下单。

corpus_topic: Blog post SEO metadata and slug update
query_text: Make a blog manager app for mobile where I can pull up any post and quickly update the title it shows in search results, the short description that appears under it, and the URL link for that post, so search engines pick up the right info and I stop having default or broken values sitting there.
query_text_zh: 做一个博客管理应用，我可以打开任何文章然后快速更新它在搜索结果里显示的标题、显示在下方的简短描述和这篇文章的网址，这样搜索引擎就能抓取正确的信息，我也不用看着那些默认值或破损的链接了。

corpus_topic: Shared document collaborative edit with conflict resolve
query_text: A shared writing tool for my phone where multiple people can edit the same document at the same time, and if two people change the same part the app surfaces both versions side by side so I can pick which one to keep or combine them, saving me from losing work or overwriting someone else's changes.
query_text_zh: 做一个共享写作工具，多人可以同时编辑同一个文档，如果两个人改了同一个地方，应用会把两个版本并排显示让我选择保留哪一个或合并它们，这样我既不会丢失工作也不会覆盖别人的改动。

corpus_topic: Inventory SKU attributes bulk update form
query_text: Create a product manager app for mobile where I can select a whole group of items at once and update shared details like price, category, or size options across all of them in one go, instead of opening each item one by one, because doing that for dozens of products is a total time sink.
query_text_zh: 做一个产品管理应用，我可以一次性选中一组商品然后批量更新它们共享的信息，比如价格、分类或尺码选项，而不用一个一个地打开每个商品，因为对几十个产品这样做实在太浪费时间了。

corpus_topic: Employee performance review update with comment thread
query_text: Need a performance review app for my phone that lets managers open an employee's review, update the ratings and written feedback, and leave comments back and forth with the employee in a running thread right on the same screen, so everything stays in one place and nothing gets buried in separate emails.
query_text_zh: 需要一个绩效评审应用，经理可以打开员工的评审记录、更新评分和反馈意见，还能在同一个屏幕上和员工来回留言讨论，这样所有内容都在一个地方，没什么会被埋在散落的邮件里。

corpus_topic: Vehicle maintenance record update with mileage
query_text: A car maintenance logger for my phone where I can find a past service record and update it with the current mileage reading, add notes about what was done this time, and save it so I always have a clean history of what happened to my car and when, sorted by the mileage I entered.
query_text_zh: 做一个汽车保养记录应用，我可以找到过去的服务记录然后用最新的里程数更新它，添加这次做了什么的备注，保存后我就始终有一份干净清晰的车辆历史记录，按照我输入的里程数排序。

corpus_topic: Lease renewal contract terms negotiation edit
query_text: Make a lease renewal app for my phone where I can review the current contract terms and propose changes to things like the monthly rent or lease length, and the landlord side can see my suggested edits and respond to each one, so we can go back and forth and settle on the final version before signing.
query_text_zh: 做一个租赁续签应用，我可以查看现有合同条款并对月租金或租期长度等条款提出改动建议，房东那边可以看到我的编辑建议并逐一回复，这样我们就能来回协商最后定下最终版本再签署。

corpus_topic: Sprint backlog story point estimate update
query_text: Make a sprint planning app for my phone where I can open any task in the backlog and quickly change the effort estimate to a number that better reflects the actual work involved, so the whole list stays accurate and the team can see the updated totals right away without waiting for the next meeting.
query_text_zh: 做一个冲刺规划应用，我可以打开待办事项里的任何任务然后快速改变工作量评估数字，改成更符合实际工作量的数字，这样整个列表就始终保持准确，团队可以立即看到更新后的总数，不用等到下次会议。

corpus_topic: Hashtag and topic label search in social feed
query_text: A social feed app for mobile where I can type in a topic or hashtag and get a list of all the posts tagged with it, with the matching label highlighted in each result so I can spot the relevant ones fast, and I can tap another label in any result to keep drilling into related topics without going back to the start.
query_text_zh: 做一个社交动态应用，我可以输入一个话题或标签然后得到所有带有这个标签的帖子列表，匹配的标签在每个结果里会高亮显示让我快速找到相关的，我还可以点击任何结果里的另一个标签继续深入相关话题，不用每次都回到开始。

corpus_topic: Document semantic search with passage highlight result
query_text: Need a document search app for my phone that lets me type a question or idea in plain words, not just exact phrases, and then shows me the relevant passages from my files with the matching parts highlighted in the text so I can actually read the context and figure out which result is the one I was looking for.
query_text_zh: 需要一个文档搜索应用，我可以用普通语言输入问题或想法，不只是精确短语，然后应用会显示我文件里相关的段落，匹配的部分会在文本里高亮出来让我看到上下文，这样我能判断哪个结果才是我要找的。

corpus_topic: In-app OCR text recognition image search
query_text: Create a photo search tool for mobile where I can take a picture of something with text in it, like a sign, a receipt, or a page, and the app reads the text from the image and pulls up other stored photos that contain similar words, so I can find things by what's written on them instead of trying to remember filenames.
query_text_zh: 做一个图片搜索工具，我可以用手机拍一张包含文字的照片，比如标志、收据或页面，应用会读取图片里的文字然后找出其他存储的包含相似词汇的照片，这样我能按照照片上写的东西来找，而不用费劲回想文件名。

corpus_topic: Nested folder deep search with breadcrumb path
query_text: A file finder app for my phone where I can search across deeply nested folders and the results show me exactly where each file lives as a trail of folder names I can tap to jump to any level, so I know the full path to what I found and can get back to the right folder without hunting around manually.
query_text_zh: 做一个文件查找应用，我可以在深层嵌套的文件夹里搜索，搜索结果会显示每个文件的确切位置，用一条能点击的文件夹路径展示，我可以点击任何层级直接跳到那个文件夹，这样我知道完整路径而且能轻易找到想要的位置，不用手动四处翻找。

corpus_topic: Code symbol and function IDE-style search
query_text: Build a code reference app for mobile where I can type the name of a function or variable and get a list of all the places in the codebase where it's defined or used, with each result showing the file name and a snippet of the surrounding lines so I can jump straight to the right spot without scrolling through everything.
query_text_zh: 做一个代码参考应用，我可以输入函数或变量名然后看到代码库里所有定义或使用这个函数或变量的地方，每个结果都显示文件名和周围代码的片段，这样我能直接跳到对的位置而不用滚动翻整个文件。

corpus_topic: Social platform username and profile search
query_text: Need a mobile app that lets me search for people across social platforms by username or display name without jumping between five different apps on my phone, it's such a time-sink. I want to type a name once and see their profile info, follower count, and what platforms they're on, all pulled up on one screen so I can figure out if it's the right person fast.
query_text_zh: 需要一个应用，我可以用用户名或昵称在多个社交平台上搜索人，不用在我手机的五个不同应用之间跳来跳去，真是太浪费时间了。我想输入一个名字然后在一个屏幕上看到他们的资料信息、粉丝数和他们在哪些平台上，这样我能快速判断是不是对的人。

corpus_topic: Transaction merchant category and amount search
query_text: Create a mobile spending tracker app where I can search my past transactions by merchant category, like restaurants or groceries, and also filter by a specific amount range, because right now I have to scroll through a giant list on my phone to find anything. The search results should show the merchant name, date, and amount clearly so I can spot patterns without any extra tapping.
query_text_zh: 做一个消费追踪应用，我可以按商户分类搜索过去的交易，比如餐厅或杂货店，还能按金额范围筛选，因为现在我只能在手机上滚动浏览巨长的列表来找东西。搜索结果应该清楚地显示商户名、日期和金额，让我不用额外点击就能看出消费规律。

query_text: Build a mobile app that works like a concept map explorer, where I can type in any topic and see how it connects to related ideas in a simple web layout on my phone. Tapping a connected concept should bring up its own set of links, so I can follow a chain of related terms without losing track of where I started. It saves me from having to Google everything separately when I'm trying to understand something new.
query_text_zh: 做一个概念地图浏览应用，我可以输入任何话题然后在手机上看到它如何和相关想法以简单的网状布局连接，点击一个相连的概念应该会展示它自己的链接集合，这样我能追踪一条相关术语的链条而不会迷失方向。当我在学习新东西时就不用分别去谷歌搜索每一样了。

query_text: Build a podcast search tool for my phone that lets me search the full text of episode transcripts by keyword, because I always remember a specific thing someone said but can never find which episode it was in. I want the results to show the episode title, a short snippet of the matching text with the keyword highlighted, and a timestamp so I can jump straight to that part without listening through the whole thing.
query_text_zh: 做一个播客搜索工具，我可以按关键词搜索剧集文本记录的全文，因为我总能记得有人说过某个特定的东西但永远找不到它出现在哪一集。我想看到剧集标题、包含关键词且关键词高亮的简短文本片段和时间戳，这样我能直接跳到那部分而不用听整整一集。

corpus_topic: Property deed and public record search
query_text: Create a property record lookup app for my phone that lets me search for deeds and public records by address or owner name, because right now I have to go to multiple county websites on my phone and none of them work well on mobile. The app should show the key details like recorded date, ownership history, and any liens, all on one clean screen so I can get the info I need without jumping between tabs.
query_text_zh: 做一个房产记录查询应用，我可以按地址或房主名字搜索地契和公共记录，因为现在我得去多个县政府网站查，而且都不支持手机浏览。应用应该在一个干净的屏幕上显示像登记日期、产权历史和任何产权留置这样的关键细节，这样我能得到我需要的信息而不用在不同标签页之间跳转。

corpus_topic: Filter preset selection with apply and save option
query_text: Build a mobile filter manager app where I can set up filter combinations, like category plus date range plus status, save them as named presets, and apply any saved preset with one tap on my phone. I want a list of my saved presets on the main screen and a clear apply button so I can switch between them quickly, plus the option to overwrite a preset after tweaking the filters.
query_text_zh: 做一个筛选管理应用，我可以设置筛选组合，比如分类加日期范围加状态，把它们保存为命名好的预设，然后在手机上一键应用任何已保存的预设。我想在主屏幕上看到已保存预设的列表和清晰的应用按钮，这样我能快速在它们之间切换，而且还能在调整筛选后覆盖某个预设。

corpus_topic: Priority level selection with color and urgency label
query_text: Build a task manager app for my phone where each task has a priority level I can set, and each level has its own color so I can see at a glance what needs doing first. I want labels like urgent, high, normal, and low, with the color showing up on the task card and a way to sort the whole list by priority level so the most urgent ones are always at the top.
query_text_zh: 做一个任务管理应用，每个任务都有我可以设置的优先级，每个优先级有自己的颜色，这样我能一眼看出什么需要首先完成。我想要像紧急、高、正常和低这样的标签，颜色会显示在任务卡片上，还要有按优先级排序整个列表的方式，这样最紧急的总是在最上面。

query_text: A notification settings app for my phone where I can pick which channels I want to use for different kinds of alerts, like email, text, and in-app, and check off as many as I want for each alert type. The main screen should list each alert category with all the channel options shown as checkboxes, and there should be a save button so my choices stick across sessions.
query_text_zh: 做一个通知设置应用，我可以为不同类型的提醒选择想要的渠道，比如邮件、短信和应用内通知，然后为每个提醒类型勾选任意多个渠道。主屏幕应该列出每个提醒分类并把所有渠道选项显示为复选框，应该有个保存按钮让我的选择在各个会话间保持。

query_text: Build a mobile insurance planner app where I can pick my deductible amount and coverage tier from a clear list, and see a side-by-side comparison of what each combination costs and covers. I want the options laid out in a simple step-by-step way on my phone, with a running summary at the bottom showing my selected deductible, tier, and estimated monthly cost so I know exactly what I'm choosing.
query_text_zh: 做一个保险规划应用，我可以从清晰的列表里选择我的免赔额金额和保险层级，然后看到每个组合成本和保险范围的并排对比。我想要选项在手机上以简单的分步方式展示，底部有一个持续更新的总结显示我选择的免赔额、层级和预估月费，这样我能确切知道我在选什么。

corpus_topic: Dashboard card metric arrangement drag select
query_text: Create a home screen organizer app for my phone where I can press and hold on any info card and drag it to a new position in the grid, so I can arrange my most important numbers, like steps, spending, and sleep, in the order I actually care about. The layout should save automatically after I rearrange things and each card should show a label and its current value clearly.
query_text_zh: 做一个主屏幕组织应用，我可以长按任何信息卡片然后拖到网格里的新位置，这样我就能按照我真正关心的顺序排列最重要的数字，比如步数、消费和睡眠。布局应该在我重新排列后自动保存，每张卡片应该清晰地显示标签和当前数值。

query_text: Create a reporting app for my phone where I can pick how I want my data displayed, like as a bar chart, line chart, or simple table, and the app updates the view right away based on my choice. I want a row of clearly labeled chart type options at the top of the report screen so I can switch between them with one tap and compare how the same data looks in different formats.
query_text_zh: 做一个报表应用，我可以选择想要显示数据的方式，比如柱状图、折线图或简单的表格，应用会根据我的选择立即更新视图。我想在报表屏幕顶部有一排清晰标记的图表类型选项，这样我能一键切换不同格式并对比同样的数据在不同呈现方式下的样子。

corpus_topic: Background music mood selection for video
query_text: Build a video music picker app for my phone where I can choose background music for my clips by mood, like calm, upbeat, dramatic, or fun, and preview a short sample of each track before picking. I want the moods listed as clearly labeled groups on the main screen so I can tap one, hear a quick clip, and confirm my choice without having to hunt through a long list of song titles I've never heard of.
query_text_zh: 做一个视频配乐选择应用，我可以按心情选择视频的背景音乐，比如平静、欢快、戏剧性或有趣，然后预听每首曲子的短片段再确定。我想在主屏幕上把心情列为清晰标记的分组，这样我可以点击一个、听一段快速片段并确认我的选择，不用在一长串我从没听过的歌曲名字里翻找。

corpus_topic: Accessibility text size and contrast chooser
query_text: Need a mobile display settings app that lets me adjust text size and screen contrast all in one place on my phone, with a live preview showing how the changes look on real text before I save anything. I want a simple slider for text size and a few preset contrast options labeled something like normal, high, and extra high, with a confirm button so nothing changes until I'm happy with it.
query_text_zh: 需要一个显示设置应用，我可以在手机的一个地方调整文字大小和屏幕对比度，有实时预览显示改动在真实文本上看起来的样子，在我保存前没什么改变。我想要一个简单的文字大小滑块和几个预设对比度选项，标记为普通、高和超高这样的标签，还有个确认按钮所以我得满意了才能保存。

corpus_topic: Academic course selection with credit count
query_text: Build a course selection planner app for my phone where I can browse available classes, add them to my schedule, and see a running total of credits I've picked so I know when I've hit my limit for the term. I want each course listed with its name, credit value, and time slot, and a counter at the top of the app that updates as I add or remove courses so I'm never guessing how many credits I have.
query_text_zh: 做一个课程选择规划应用，我可以浏览可用的课程、加入到我的课程表、看到我已选课程的持续总学分数，这样我能知道什么时候达到这学期的限额。我想看到每门课的课程名、学分值和上课时间，应用顶部有个计数器，当我添加或删除课程时实时更新，这样我永远不会猜测自己选了多少学分。

query_text: Need a mobile investment profile tool that walks me through a few plain-language questions about how much risk I'm comfortable with, like whether I'd rather protect my money or try to grow it faster, and then shows me which investor type I match. I want the result screen to show my profile label, a short description of what it means, and a breakdown of how a typical portfolio for that profile is split across different types of investments.
query_text_zh: 需要一个投资档案工具，它会问我几个简单易懂的问题关于我能接受的风险程度，比如我是想保护我的钱还是想更快地增长，然后告诉我我符合哪个投资者类型。我想在结果屏幕上看到我的档案标签、它的意思的简短描述和一个典型的这个档案投资组合是如何在不同投资类型间分配的。

corpus_topic: Saved audience segment filter in analytics report
query_text: Create a mobile analytics viewer app where I can save audience filter combinations, like age range plus location plus device type, and reload any saved group with a single tap to see the report update right away on my phone. I just want a list of my saved filters with names I can set myself, and a clear apply button so I can switch between different audience views without setting up the same filters from scratch every single time.
query_text_zh: 做一个分析浏览应用，我可以保存受众筛选组合，比如年龄范围加位置加设备类型，然后用一个点击来重新加载任何已保存的分组，在我手机上立即看到报表更新。我只想要一个我可以自己命名的已保存筛选列表，和一个清晰的应用按钮，这样我能在不同的受众视图间切换而不用每次都从零开始设置相同的筛选。

corpus_topic: Filter with pin-to-top result and sticky header
query_text: Need a mobile list manager app that lets me filter my items and then pin the most important results to the top of the list so they stay visible while I scroll through the rest. The filter bar should stick at the top of the screen on my phone so I can always see what's active and change it without scrolling back up, which would save me so much back-and-forth when I'm working through a long list.
query_text_zh: 需要一个列表管理应用，我可以筛选我的项目然后把最重要的结果钉到列表顶部所以滚动时它们始终可见。筛选栏应该粘在手机屏幕顶部让我总是能看到什么是活跃的并改变它而不用向上滚动回到开始，这能省我多少来回时间啊，当我在处理一个长列表时。

corpus_topic: Customer segment filter by lifetime value
query_text: Make a customer tracking app for my phone where I can filter my customer list by how much total money they've spent with me over time, so I can separate the regulars who buy a lot from the ones who haven't come back much. I want to set a spending range or pick tiers like high value, mid range, and occasional, and the filtered list should show each customer's name and their total spend so I can follow up with the right people.
query_text_zh: 做一个客户追踪应用，我可以按他们随着时间的总消费额筛选客户列表，这样我能把经常来购买很多的常客和没怎么回头的人分开。我想设置消费范围或选择高价值、中等和偶尔这样的层级，筛选后的列表应该显示每个客户的名字和他们的总消费额，这样我能跟进对的人。

corpus_topic: Research library filter by impact factor
query_text: Create a research paper finder app for my phone where I can filter results by how highly cited or influential the journal is, because I always waste time opening papers only to find they're from low-quality sources. I want a slider or tier options to set a minimum quality level, and each result should show the journal name and a simple quality indicator so I can decide quickly whether it's worth reading.
query_text_zh: 做一个研究论文查找应用，我可以按期刊被引用的频率或影响力来筛选结果，因为我总是浪费时间打开最后发现它们来自低质量期刊的论文。我想要一个滑块或分层选项来设置最低质量水平，每个结果应该显示期刊名和一个简单的质量指标，这样我能快速判断是否值得读。

corpus_topic: Medical symptom filter by severity and onset
query_text: A symptom checker app for my phone where I can narrow down a list of possible symptoms by how severe they feel, like mild, moderate, or serious, and also by whether they came on suddenly or slowly over time. The filtered results should show each symptom with a short plain-language description so I can check off what matches my situation and get a clearer picture of what might be going on before I decide if I need to see a doctor.
query_text_zh: 做一个症状检查应用，我可以按症状感觉的严重程度筛选可能症状的列表，比如轻微、中度或严重，还能按症状是突然出现还是慢慢发展筛选。筛选后的结果应该显示每个症状和简单易懂的简短描述，这样我能勾选符合我情况的，更清楚地了解可能发生了什么，然后再决定是否需要看医生。

query_text: Create a compliance document manager app for my phone where I can filter my saved documents by the country or region whose rules they relate to, like EU, US, or specific states, so I can pull up only the ones relevant to a project I'm working on. I want the filter options as a simple list I can tap through on my phone, and the results should show the document name, jurisdiction, and last updated date so I know I'm looking at the right version.
query_text_zh: 做一个合规文档管理应用，我可以按文档适用的国家或地区来筛选已保存的文档，比如欧盟、美国或特定州，这样我能只找出与我在做的项目相关的文档。我想要把筛选选项作为一个简单列表显示在手机上我可以点击，结果应该显示文档名、司法管辖区和最后更新日期，这样我能确信我看的是对的版本。

corpus_topic: Marketplace listing filter by seller rating
query_text: Make a second-hand marketplace app for my phone where I can filter listings by the seller's rating so I only see stuff from people with good reviews. I want to set a minimum star rating with a simple slider or preset options like 4 stars and up, and each listing card should show the seller's rating alongside the item photo and price so I can trust what I'm buying before I even tap into the details.
query_text_zh: 做一个二手市场应用，我可以按卖家评分来筛选列表，这样我只看到来自评价好的人的东西。我想用一个简单的滑块或像4星及以上这样的预设选项来设置最低星级评分，每个商品卡片应该在商品照片和价格旁边显示卖家评分，这样在我甚至点击查看细节前我就能信任我买的东西。

corpus_topic: Portfolio asset class and region filter
query_text: An investment tracker app for my phone where I can filter my holdings by asset type, like stocks, bonds, or cash, and also by region, like domestic or international, so I can quickly see how my money is split up without doing the math myself. The filter should update the list on the spot when I tap an option, and each holding should show the asset name, type, region, and current value so I have everything I need in one view.
query_text_zh: 做一个投资追踪应用，我可以按资产类型筛选我的持仓，比如股票、债券或现金，还能按地区筛选，比如国内或国际，这样我能快速看到我的钱是怎样分配的而不用自己计算。筛选应该在我点击选项时立即更新列表，每个持仓应该显示资产名、类型、地区和当前价值，这样我能在一个视图里拥有我需要的所有信息。

corpus_topic: Leaderboard rank filter by region and age
query_text: Make a leaderboard app for my phone where I can filter the rankings by region, like by country or city, and also by age group, so I can see how I stack up against people who are actually comparable to me. I want the filter options clearly laid out at the top of the app and the list to update right away when I change them, with each entry showing the rank, name, score, and the person's region and age group.
query_text_zh: 做一个排行榜应用，我可以按地区筛选排名，比如按国家或城市，还能按年龄组筛选，这样我能看到我和真正可比的人相比排名如何。我想要筛选选项清晰地排列在应用顶部，当我改变它们时列表立即更新，每条记录显示排名、名字、分数以及这个人的地区和年龄组。

corpus_topic: Support queue filter by SLA urgency
query_text: Make a support ticket manager app for my phone where I can filter the queue by how urgent each ticket is based on the deadline for resolving it, so I always know which ones need attention first. I want a simple set of urgency levels like overdue, due soon, and on track, and tapping one should instantly show only tickets in that group, with each ticket listing the customer name, issue summary, and the time remaining before the deadline.
query_text_zh: 做一个支持工单管理应用，我可以按每个工单的紧急程度筛选队列，根据解决的截止日期来判断，这样我总知道哪些需要首先关注。我想要简单的紧急程度级别，比如逾期、即将到期和按计划，点击一个应该立即只显示这个组里的工单，每个工单列出客户名、问题摘要和距离截止期限的时间。

corpus_topic: Remove integration with OAuth token revocation confirmation
query_text: Make a mobile app that handles removing an OAuth token revocation confirmation so I can just disconnect a connected account in one tap without being asked the same thing twice, because going through multiple confirmation steps every time is such a waste. The app should list all linked connections on one screen, let me tap to remove one, and just do it cleanly with a simple final check before the token gets killed.
query_text_zh: 做一个手机应用，简化OAuth令牌撤销确认流程，这样我就能一次点击就断开已连接的账户，不用被问同样的问题两遍。应用应该把所有关联的账户列在一个屏幕上，我点击一个账户就能删除它，然后有个简单的最终确认，就直接撤销令牌了。

corpus_topic: Detach media from post while keeping post text intact
query_text: Create a mobile app for managing posts where I can detach photos or videos from a post while keeping all the text I already wrote completely intact, because sometimes I upload the wrong image and I just want to swap it out without losing my caption. The post editor screen should clearly show the attached media and let me remove it with one tap, leaving my written content right where it was.
query_text_zh: 做一个手机应用来管理帖子，我能从帖子上删除照片或视频，但要保留我已经写好的所有文字，因为有时候我会上传错误的图片，我只想换一个但不想丢掉我的文案。应用的帖子编辑屏幕应该清楚地显示附加的媒体，让我轻点一下就删除，文字内容就原样保留。

corpus_topic: Scheduled post cancel and move to draft
query_text: Create a mobile app for managing scheduled posts where I can cancel a post that is set to go out later and have it saved back as a draft automatically, so I do not have to rewrite anything if I change my mind. On the scheduled posts screen I want to be able to tap a post, hit cancel, and have it move right into my drafts folder with everything still there.
query_text_zh: 做一个手机应用来管理定时发布的帖子，我可以取消一个稍后要发出去的帖子，它会自动保存为草稿，这样如果我改变主意的话就不用重新写。在定时发布的帖子屏幕上，我想轻点一个帖子，点击取消，它就直接进入我的草稿文件夹，所有内容都还在。

corpus_topic: Friend request decline with block option
query_text: Make a mobile app for handling incoming friend requests where I can decline a request and also choose to block that person at the same time in one smooth step, because having to do it separately is annoying when someone keeps sending requests. When I tap on a pending request on my phone it should give me the option to just decline, or to decline and block, so I can deal with it once and move on.
query_text_zh: 做一个手机应用来处理好友请求，我能拒绝一个请求，同时也能在一个步骤里把这个人加入黑名单，不用分开操作。有人不停地发好友请求的时候特别烦人。在我的手机上，轻点一个待处理的请求应该给我两个选项：只是拒绝，或者拒绝并黑名单，这样我能一次性处理完然后继续干别的。

corpus_topic: Subscription pause with refund grace period
query_text: Need a mobile app that lets me pause a subscription and shows me a clear window of time where I can still ask for a refund before the pause locks in, because sometimes I forget to cancel in time and I need to know exactly how long I have. The app should show my active subscriptions, let me tap to pause one, and display a plain countdown of the refund grace period so I know where I stand.
query_text_zh: 需要一个手机应用，可以暂停订阅，并且清楚地显示在暂停锁定前还有多长时间能申请退款，因为我有时候会忘记及时取消，需要知道具体还有多少时间。应用应该显示我的活跃订阅，我轻点其中一个就能暂停，然后显示退款宽限期的简单倒计时，这样我就知道自己的情况了。

corpus_topic: Selective app data reset with category picker
query_text: A mobile data cleanup tool where I can pick which categories of saved data to wipe from the app, like only clearing my search history or only my saved addresses, instead of having to reset everything at once. The main screen for my phone should show a simple list of data categories I can check off, then confirm and clear just those selected ones, so I stop losing settings I actually want to keep.
query_text_zh: 做一个手机数据清理工具，我能选择只清理某些类别的保存数据，比如只清除搜索历史或只清除保存的地址，而不是一次性全部重置。手机的主屏幕应该显示一个简单的数据类别列表，我能勾选，然后确认并清理只是那些选中的数据，这样我就不会丢掉我想保留的设置了。

corpus_topic: Co-author write permission revoke from document
query_text: Need a mobile app for managing shared documents where I can find a co-author and take away their ability to edit a specific document, switching them down to read-only, because sometimes a project is done and I just want to lock it down. The document manager should list everyone who has write access to each file so I can tap on a name and change their permission right from my phone.
query_text_zh: 需要一个手机应用来管理共享文档，我能找到一个合作者，然后移除他对某个特定文档的编辑权限，把他改成只读，因为有时候项目完成了我就想锁定下来。应用的文档管理器应该列出每个文件的所有有写权限的人，我能在手机上轻点一个名字就改变他们的权限。

corpus_topic: Alert rule deactivate with archive keep
query_text: Need a mobile app for managing alert rules where I can switch off a rule so it stops firing but the rule itself stays saved in an archive so I can turn it back on later if I need it, because deleting rules and recreating them from scratch is a huge hassle. On my phone the alert manager should have a clear active versus archived list and let me move a rule between the two with a single tap.
query_text_zh: 需要一个手机应用来管理告警规则，我能关闭一个规则让它停止触发，但规则本身还保存在存档里，这样我之后如果需要就能重新打开，因为删除规则然后从头重建太麻烦了。在我的手机上，告警管理器应该清楚地分开活跃和存档列表，我能用一次轻点把规则在两个列表之间移动。

corpus_topic: Referral code expire and batch deactivate
query_text: Build a mobile app for managing referral codes where I can set an expiry date on individual codes and also select multiple codes at once to deactivate them all in one go, because manually turning off codes one by one when a campaign ends takes way too long. The app for my phone should show all my active codes in a list, let me pick several at once, and kill them with a single confirm tap.
query_text_zh: 做一个手机应用来管理推荐码，我能给单个代码设置过期日期，也能一次选中多个代码同时停用它们，因为在活动结束时逐个关闭代码实在花太多时间了。我手机上的应用应该显示所有活跃的代码列表，让我一次选中好几个，然后一次轻点就全部关闭。

corpus_topic: Linked bank account unlink with balance confirm
query_text: Build a mobile app for managing linked payment methods where I can remove a connected bank account and have the app show me the current balance and any pending charges before I confirm, so I know there is nothing left to process before I cut the connection. On my phone the account manager should pull up the balance summary clearly and then let me confirm the unlink in one final step.
query_text_zh: 做一个手机应用来管理关联的支付方式，我能删除一个已连接的银行账户，应用在我确认前应该显示当前余额和任何待处理费用，这样我就知道在断开连接前没有什么需要处理。在我的手机上，账户管理器应该清楚地拉出余额摘要，然后让我在最后一步确认取消关联。

l2_scene_label: Editing Profile 编辑个人资料
corpus_topic: Pronouns and custom identity field with free input
query_text: Build a profile editor app where the pronouns and identity section feels thoughtful and personal, not like a government form, so people can pick from a few gentle preset options or just type in whatever feels right for them. The vibe on mobile should be soft and welcoming, with enough breathing room that filling in your identity feels like self-expression, and the free-text field should sit right alongside the presets so nothing feels hidden or secondary.
query_text_zh: 做一个个人资料编辑应用，代词和身份部分要感觉有思想、有人文气息，不像政府表格那样冷冰冰的，这样人们可以从几个温和的预设选项中选择，或者直接输入对他们来说对的任何东西。手机上的感觉应该温柔又欢迎，有足够的空间让填写身份感觉像是自我表达，自由文本字段应该和预设选项挨在一起，这样没有什么感觉是隐藏或次要的。

l2_scene_label: Editing Profile 编辑个人资料
corpus_topic: Emergency contact and health profile setup wizard
query_text: Create a mobile setup guide app that walks someone through filling in their emergency contacts and basic health details one calm step at a time, like a gentle checklist that actually feels reassuring rather than clinical. The flow on your phone should have a warm, caring aesthetic with clear sections for each type of information, so by the end you feel prepared rather than overwhelmed.
query_text_zh: 做一个手机设置指南应用，温和地逐个步骤地引导用户填入紧急联系人和基本健康信息，就像一个放心的检查清单，感觉真的很温心而不是冷冰冰的医学风格。你手机上的流程应该有温暖、关怀的美感，清楚地分出每种信息的板块，这样到最后你感觉是有准备的，而不是不知所措的。

l2_scene_label: Editing Profile 编辑个人资料
corpus_topic: Nonprofit volunteer cause and skills profile
query_text: Need a mobile app for volunteer profiles that lets someone describe the causes they care about and the skills they can offer in a way that feels genuine and human, not like a resume. The profile on your phone should have a warm, community-driven look where you can write a little about why certain causes matter to you and list a handful of skills in a way that feels personal rather than just a checkbox list.
query_text_zh: 需要一个手机应用来管理志愿者资料，让人们能真诚、人性地描述他们关心的事业和能提供的技能，不像简历那样死板。你手机上的资料应该有温暖、社区驱动的感觉，你能写一点你为什么关心某些事业，然后以个人化的方式列出一些技能，而不只是复选框列表。

l2_scene_label: Editing Profile 编辑个人资料
query_text: Create a mobile profile app for legal professionals where they can fill in their bar registration details in a way that still feels polished and dignified, because credentials deserve to be presented well. The app on your phone should give each piece of information room to breathe, with a clean, authoritative feel, so your bar number and practice area come across as credentials worth trusting rather than just data in a form.
query_text_zh: 做一个手机资料应用给法律专业人士，他们能填入律师执业证登记信息，看起来仍然精致又有尊严，因为资格证书值得好好展示。你手机上的应用应该给每条信息留出空间，有清洁、权威的感觉，这样你的执业证号和执业领域看起来就像是值得信任的资格证，而不只是表格里的数据。

l2_scene_label: Editing Profile 编辑个人资料
query_text: A patient health baseline app for mobile where someone setting up telemedicine access can fill in their ongoing conditions, past procedures, and regular medications in a calm and organized way, almost like a quiet personal health journal. The profile on your phone should feel reassuring rather than sterile, with clearly separated sections for different parts of your health history so a doctor reading it can get a real picture of you as a person.
query_text_zh: 做一个患者健康基线应用给手机，有人设置远程医疗访问时能以平静、有条理的方式填入现有的病情、过往手术和常规用药，就像一个安静的个人健康日志。你手机上的资料应该感觉令人安心而不是无菌的医学风格，有清楚的不同版块分出你健康史的不同部分，这样医生读它时能真正了解你作为一个人的完整情况。

l2_scene_label: Editing Profile 编辑个人资料
query_text: Make a mobile profile app for a religious community where members can fill in their role in the congregation and any groups they belong to, with a look and feel that is warm and reverent rather than generic. On your phone the profile should feel like it belongs to a real spiritual community, with a gentle color palette and clear sections for things like your role, your ministry involvements, and a short personal note.
query_text_zh: 做一个手机资料应用给宗教社区，成员能填入他们在会众中的角色和任何他们属于的小组，看起来温暖又虔诚而不是通用风格。你手机上的资料应该像是属于一个真正的精神社区，有温柔的调色板和清楚的版块，比如你的角色、你的事工参与和一个简短的个人备注。

l2_scene_label: Editing Profile 编辑个人资料
query_text: Need a mobile app where I can set up a personal finance profile that captures how I actually think about money, like whether I am saving for something specific, how cautious or relaxed I am with spending, and what my rough monthly budget is, so the app can tailor things to my style. The profile setup on my phone should feel like a thoughtful quiz with a calm, organized aesthetic rather than a bunch of intimidating numbers.
query_text_zh: 需要一个手机应用，我能设置个人理财资料，捕捉我是怎样真正思考金钱的，比如我是不是在存钱买什么特定的东西、我在花钱上是小心还是随意、大概的每月预算是多少，这样应用能根据我的风格量身定制。我手机上的资料设置应该像是一个贴心的测验，有平静、有条理的美感，而不是一堆令人畏惧的数字。

l2_scene_label: Editing Profile 编辑个人资料
corpus_topic: Expat community home city and language profile
query_text: A profile builder for an expat community app on mobile where members can set their home city, the languages they speak, and where they are currently living, all presented in a way that feels warm and global rather than like filling out a visa application. The profile screen on your phone should feel inviting, like a little window into where someone is from and where they are now, with a light and friendly design that makes people actually want to fill it in.
query_text_zh: 做一个个人资料生成器给海外人士社区应用，成员能设置他们的家乡城市、他们说的语言、现在住在哪里，所有的都用温暖、全球化的方式呈现，而不像填签证申请。你手机上的资料屏幕应该感觉邀请人心，就像一个小窗口看进去某个人来自哪里现在在哪里，设计轻盈又友好，让人们真的想填进去。

l2_scene_label: Editing Profile 编辑个人资料
corpus_topic: Online marketplace buyer trust score profile
query_text: Create a buyer profile app for an online marketplace where people can see and build up their trust score over time, with a look that feels credible and clean rather than cluttered, because first impressions matter when you are buying from strangers. The profile on your phone should display the trust score prominently in a way that feels earned and honest, with a calm visual style that makes buyers look reliable to sellers.
query_text_zh: 做一个在线市场的买家资料应用，人们能看到并逐时积累他们的信任分数，看起来可信又清晰而不是乱七八糟的，因为当你从陌生人那里购买时第一印象很重要。你手机上的资料应该显著地显示信任分数，感觉像是赚来的又诚实的，用平静的视觉风格让买家对卖家看起来可靠。

l2_scene_label: Editing Profile 编辑个人资料
corpus_topic: Performing arts ensemble role and audition
query_text: Create a mobile profile app for performing arts groups where members can list the ensembles they belong to, their role in each one, and any upcoming auditions they are preparing for, with a look that feels artistic and expressive rather than like a spreadsheet. The profile on your phone should feel like it belongs to a real creative community, with a rich layout where your performance history and audition plans both get space to shine.
query_text_zh: 做一个表演艺术团体的手机资料应用，成员能列出他们属于的乐团、他们在每个乐团中的角色、任何他们正在准备的即将举行的试镜，看起来艺术又富有表现力而不像电子表格。你手机上的资料应该像是属于一个真正有创意的社区，有丰富的布局，你的演出历史和试镜计划都有空间闪耀。

corpus_topic: Attachment download from message thread list
query_text: Need a mobile app where I can browse my message threads and download attachments that people sent me without having to open every single conversation to dig them out, because hunting through old chats for a file someone shared weeks ago is a real pain. On my phone the app should show me a combined list of all the files and photos from my threads so I can tap one and save it straight to my phone.
query_text_zh: 需要一个手机应用，我能浏览我的消息线程并下载人们发给我的附件，不用打开每一个对话逐个挖掘，因为在旧聊天里搜找某个人几周前分享的文件实在太麻烦了。我手机上的应用应该显示一个汇总的所有线程中的所有文件和照片列表，这样我能轻点其中一个直接保存到我的手机。

query_text: Need a mobile app with a setting that makes it only sync my data when I am connected to Wi-Fi, so I stop burning through my phone data without knowing it, but I also want a way to manually kick off a sync when I am on mobile data just for that one time. The settings screen on my phone should make the Wi-Fi-only toggle easy to find and the manual sync button should be right there so I do not have to go hunting for it.
query_text_zh: 需要一个手机应用，有一个设置让它只在我连接Wi-Fi时同步数据，这样我就停止不知不觉地燃烧流量，但我也想有个办法在用移动数据时手动发起一次同步，就只为这一次。我手机上的设置屏幕应该让Wi-Fi专用切换轻易找到，手动同步按钮应该就在那里，这样我不用到处翻找。

corpus_topic: Legal contract digital signature upload flow
query_text: Create a mobile app for uploading signed legal contracts where I can either draw my signature right on my phone screen or import a signature image and then attach it to a document before sending it off, because printing and scanning is a huge hassle. The app should walk me through picking the document, adding the signature in the right spot, and confirming the upload all in a few taps so the whole thing takes under a minute.
query_text_zh: 做一个手机应用来上传签署的法律合同，我可以直接在我的手机屏幕上绘制我的签名，或导入一个签名图像，然后把它附加到一个文档上发送，因为打印和扫描太麻烦了。应用应该逐步引导我选择文档、在正确的地方添加签名、确认上传，都在几次轻点内完成，这样整个事情不到一分钟就搞定。

query_text: Build a mobile survey tool where one of the question types lets people answer by taking a photo or picking one from their phone gallery, so respondents can just snap a picture of whatever they are describing instead of typing it all out. The survey flow on my phone should make the photo question feel as easy as the regular text ones, with a clear capture button and a small preview so people know their image was attached before they move on.
query_text_zh: 做一个手机调查工具，其中一种问题类型让人们能通过拍照或从他们手机相册选择一张照片来回答，这样受访者能直接拍一张他们在描述的东西的照片而不用全部打字。我手机上的调查流程应该让照片问题感觉和普通文本问题一样简单，有个清楚的捕获按钮和一个小预览，这样人们在继续前知道他们的图像已经附加上了。

query_text: Build a mobile thesis submission tool where students can upload several required files at once, like the main document, the cover sheet, and supplementary materials, and see each one go through with a clear status so they know exactly what landed and what still needs to be sent. The app on my phone should handle multiple files in a single submission run and show a confirmation summary so I am not second-guessing whether my work actually went through.
query_text_zh: 做一个手机学位论文提交工具，学生能一次上传多个必需的文件，比如主文档、封面和补充材料，并看到每个文件都经历一个清楚的状态，这样他们就知道确切什么是成功上传的什么还需要发送。我手机上的应用应该在单个提交中处理多个文件并显示一个确认摘要，这样我不用猜测我的工作是否真的通过了。

query_text: A field inspection photo uploader for my phone where I can take photos on-site and each one automatically gets tagged with my current GPS location before it goes up, so I never have to manually type in where I was standing. The app should show a list of my uploaded photos with a small map pin label on each one, and I can group them by inspection job so everything stays organized without extra effort.
query_text_zh: 做一个现场检查照片上传器给我的手机，我能现场拍照，每一张都会自动用我当前的GPS位置标记，然后上传，这样我永远不用手动输入我站的地方。应用应该显示我上传的照片列表，每个都有一个小地图图标标签，我能按检查工作分组这样一切都保持整理好不用额外努力。

corpus_topic: Smart meter data export CSV download
query_text: A smart meter data tool on my phone that saves me the hassle of copying numbers by hand, letting me pull my meter readings for any date range and download the whole thing as a CSV file straight to my phone, so I can hand it off to whoever needs it. The app should show the readings in a simple list first so I can check the data looks right before I download.
query_text_zh: 我手机上的一个智能电表数据工具，省去我手动抄数字的麻烦，让我提取任何日期范围内的电表读数并把整个东西下载为一个CSV文件直接到我的手机，这样我能把它交给需要它的人。应用应该先显示读数在一个简单的列表里，这样我能检查数据看起来没问题再下载。

query_text: Make a QA inspection report exporter for the factory floor that works on mobile, where I can fill in the inspection results for each batch right on my phone and then export the whole report as a file I can send to my supervisor. The app should let me pick which production line and date the check was done, then bundle everything into one clean report I can share without having to copy anything manually.
query_text_zh: 做一个QA检查报告导出器给工厂生产线用，在手机上工作，我能填入每批的检查结果直接在我的手机上，然后把整个报告导出为一个文件我能发给我的主管。应用应该让我选择哪条生产线和检查是什么时候做的，然后把一切打包成一个干净的报告我能分享不用手动复制任何东西。

query_text: Create a visa document checklist app for my phone that tells me exactly which papers I need to upload for my immigration application and lets me tick off each one as I go. Each item on the list should have an upload spot right next to it so I can attach the file immediately, and the app should show me at a glance which documents are still missing so I stop losing track of what I already submitted.
query_text_zh: 做一个签证文件检查清单应用给我的手机，告诉我对我的移民申请需要上传确切什么文件，让我在进行中逐个勾选。列表中每一项应该有一个紧挨着的上传位置，这样我能立即附加文件，应用应该一眼显示给我什么文件还缺少，这样我停止丢失我已经提交的东西的踪迹。

corpus_topic: Social media scheduled batch media upload
query_text: Make a social media scheduler tool for my phone where I can queue up a bunch of photos and videos at once and set a specific date and time for each batch to go out, so I stop scrambling to post manually every single day. The app should let me pick multiple files in one go, assign them to a scheduled slot, and show me a simple calendar view of everything that is lined up to be posted.
query_text_zh: 做一个手机社交媒体调度器工具，我能一次排队很多照片和视频，给每批设置一个具体的日期和时间来发出，这样我停止每一天都匆忙地手动发布。应用应该让我一次选中多个文件，指派它们到一个计划的时段，显示一个简单的日历视图所有已排队要发布的东西。

corpus_topic: Clone alert rule for different metric threshold
query_text: Build a mobile alert rule manager where I can see all my existing alert rules in a list and tap a copy button on any one of them to duplicate it, then just change the number threshold for the new copy without having to fill in every field from scratch. The app should let me give the cloned rule a new name and pick a different metric limit right after copying, so I can set up a whole family of similar alerts without doing the same repetitive work over and over.
query_text_zh: 做一个手机告警规则管理器，我能看到我所有现有的告警规则在一个列表里，轻点任何一个上的复制按钮来复制它，然后只是改变新副本的数字阈值不用从头填入每个字段。应用应该让我给克隆的规则给个新名字和选择一个不同的指标限制就在复制后，这样我能设置整个类似的告警家族不用一遍遍重复做同样的工作。

corpus_topic: Copy config from staging to production environment
query_text: Make a config copying tool that works on my phone, where I can see all the settings from my test environment listed out and tap a button to push the whole thing over to the live environment in one shot. The app should show me a side-by-side comparison of what is in each environment before I confirm, so I can catch any differences and avoid accidentally overwriting something important.
query_text_zh: 做一个在我手机上工作的配置复制工具，我能看到我的测试环境的所有设置列出来，轻点一个按钮把整个东西在一发送到实时环境。应用应该在我确认前给我一个测试和实时环境的并排对比，这样我能抓到任何差异并避免不小心覆盖什么重要的东西。

corpus_topic: Tax filing prior-year data copy and prefill
query_text: Create a tax filing helper app for my phone that pulls in the numbers I entered last year and fills them into this year's form automatically, so I spend less time hunting through old paperwork. The app should show me which fields were copied from last year highlighted, so I can quickly review and update anything that changed, rather than re-typing the same information all over again.
query_text_zh: 做一个手机税务备案帮手应用，拉入我去年输入的数字并自动填入今年的表格，这样我花更少时间翻找旧文件。应用应该显示哪些字段是从去年复制来的用高亮标出，这样我能快速审查和更新任何改变了的东西，而不用一遍遍重新输入同样的信息。

query_text: Need a mobile retrospective board tool that lets my team clone a pre-made meeting template at the start of each sprint, so we can skip all the setup and just get straight to filling it in. The app should show a list of saved templates I can copy with one tap, then let everyone add their own notes to the cloned board from their phones during the meeting without overwriting each other.
query_text_zh: 需要一个手机回顾板工具，让我的团队在每个冲刺开始时克隆一个预做的会议模板，这样我们能跳过所有设置直接开始填进去。应用应该显示一个我能用一次轻点复制的已保存模板列表，然后让每个人在会议期间从他们的手机添加他们自己的备注到克隆的板上不用相互覆盖。

query_text: A customer journey planning tool for my phone where each stage of the journey is its own card, and I can tap any card to make an exact copy of it so I can reuse the same structure for a new stage without typing everything again. The app should let me rename the duplicate and edit just the parts that differ from the original, saving me from rebuilding the same touchpoints and notes from scratch every single time.
query_text_zh: 一个我手机上的客户旅程规划工具，旅程的每个阶段是它自己的卡片，我能轻点任何卡片做一个精确的副本，这样我能重用同样的结构给新的阶段不用打一切。应用应该让我重新命名复制的东西并只编辑和原始的不同的部分，省了我每次从头重建同样的接触点和备注。

corpus_topic: Loyalty tier benefit structure copy and adjust
query_text: Build a loyalty program manager on mobile where I can view all my existing membership tier setups and copy one tier's benefit list to use as a starting point for a new tier, then just tweak the perks and limits instead of writing everything out fresh. The app should let me rename the copied tier and adjust individual benefits one by one, so spinning up a new level takes a minute instead of half a day.
query_text_zh: 做一个手机忠诚度项目管理器，我能查看我所有现有的会员等级设置并复制一个等级的权益列表用作新等级的起点，然后只是调整福利和限制代替从头写。应用应该让我重新命名复制的等级并逐个调整单个权益，这样推出新的等级花一分钟代替半天。

corpus_topic: Production environment config copy to staging
query_text: Need a mobile config sync tool that lets me take the current live server settings and copy them down to the test environment with one tap, so I can make sure my tests are running against real conditions. The app should show me a clear summary of what settings are about to be copied before I confirm, and highlight anything that looks different between the two environments so I can decide whether to keep or skip it.
query_text_zh: 需要一个手机配置同步工具，让我用一次轻点把当前实时服务器设置复制下来到测试环境，这样我能确保我的测试在真实条件下运行。应用应该在我确认前显示一个什么设置关于被复制的清楚摘要，并高亮任何在两个环境间看起来不同的东西，这样我能决定是否保持或跳过它。

corpus_topic: Product bundle copy with new pricing
query_text: Build a product bundle manager for my phone where I can see all my existing bundles and tap any one to make a copy of it, then update the price and any included items for the new version without starting from zero. The app should let me preview what the copied bundle looks like before saving, so I can quickly roll out a promotional version with adjusted pricing and confirm everything looks right from my phone.
query_text_zh: 做一个手机产品包裹管理器，我能看到我所有现存的包裹并轻点任何一个来复制它，然后为新版本更新价格和任何包括的项目而不从零开始。应用应该让我在保存前预览复制的包裹看起来什么样，这样我能快速推出一个有调整后定价的促销版本并从我的手机确认一切看起来对。

corpus_topic: Invoice line item copy to new invoice
query_text: Need a mobile invoice tool that lets me open any past invoice, select the line items I want, and copy them straight into a brand-new invoice so I stop retyping the same services and prices every month. The app should let me pick which items to carry over, adjust the quantities or amounts for the new invoice, and show me a running total as I go so I know the final number before I send it.
query_text_zh: 需要一个手机发票工具，让我打开任何过往发票，选择我想要的行项目，直接复制它们到一个全新发票这样我停止每个月重新输入同样的服务和价格。应用应该让我选择哪些项目要携带，调整新发票的数量或金额，我进行时显示一个运行的总数这样我知道最后的数字在我发送它之前。

query_text: Create a shift planner app for my phone where I can set up one week's worth of shift rotations and then duplicate that whole pattern to fill in the next several weeks automatically, instead of manually entering the same schedule over and over. The app should show the repeated weeks in a calendar so I can spot any conflicts and make small edits to specific days without having to redo the whole rotation from scratch.
query_text_zh: 做一个手机班次规划器应用，我能设置一周的班次轮转然后复制那个整个模式来自动填充接下来的几周，代替手动输入同样的计划一遍遍。应用应该在日历显示重复的周这样我能发现任何冲突并做小编辑到特定的日子不用从头重新做整个轮转。

corpus_topic: In-app purchase paywall with free-trial option
query_text: Need a little mobile app for my phone that shows a paywall screen when a free user tries to use a paid feature, giving them the option to start a free trial before committing to a subscription. The screen should clearly show what they get during the trial period, how long it lasts, and a simple button to start it, so there is no confusion about what they are signing up for.
query_text_zh: 需要一个小手机应用给我的手机，当一个免费用户尝试使用一个付费功能时显示一个付费墙屏幕，给他们选项在承诺订阅前开始免费试用。屏幕应该清楚地显示他们在试用期间得到什么，它持续多长时间，和一个简单的开始试用按钮，这样对他们在注册什么就没有困惑。

corpus_topic: Accessibility audit result and quick-fix panel
query_text: Create a mobile accessibility checker tool that scans a page and shows me a list of issues it found, grouped by how serious they are, so I can see the biggest problems first. For each issue the app should offer a quick one-tap fix suggestion right there on the phone, so I can clean up the most common problems on the spot without having to dig through documentation to figure out what to do.
query_text_zh: 做一个手机无障碍检查器工具扫描一个页面并显示给我一个它找到的问题列表，按他们有多严重分组，这样我能先看最大的问题。对每个问题应用应该直接在手机上提供一个快速一轻点的修复建议，这样我能立即清理最常见的问题而不用翻找文档来找出做什么。

corpus_topic: Face ID and fingerprint biometric enrollment
query_text: Create a biometric setup app for my phone that walks me through enrolling my face and fingerprint one step at a time, so I know exactly what to do and do not get confused by the process. The app should show a clear progress indicator for each enrollment step, let me try the scan again if it does not work the first time, and confirm at the end that both my face and fingerprint are saved and ready to use.
query_text_zh: 做一个手机生物测定设置应用，逐个步骤地引导我注册我的脸和指纹，这样我知道确切做什么不会在过程中困惑。应用应该显示每个注册步骤的一个清楚的进度指示，让我如果它第一次不行我能试扫描再来，并在最后确认我的脸和指纹都保存并准备使用。

corpus_topic: Home screen widget add and resize
query_text: Make a mobile home screen customizer app where I can pick from a list of small info blocks to add to my phone's home screen, and then drag the corners to make each one bigger or smaller so it fits the space I have. The app should show a live preview of how my home screen will look as I add and resize things, so I can arrange everything exactly how I want it before applying the changes.
query_text_zh: 做一个手机主屏幕定制器应用，我能从小信息块列表中选择加到我手机主屏幕上，然后拖动拐角让每个更大或更小这样它适应我有的空间。应用应该显示一个实时预览当我添加和调整东西时我的主屏幕会看起来什么样，这样我能在应用改变前安排一切完全如我想要的。

query_text: Need a mobile setup guide app that walks new users through turning on helpful accessibility features on their phone, one feature at a time, so they can find options that make the app easier to use without having to dig through a bunch of settings menus on their own. Each step should show what the feature does in plain language with a simple toggle, and the guide should remember which ones the user already turned on so they can come back and adjust later.
query_text_zh: 需要一个手机设置指南应用，逐个功能地引导新用户打开有帮助的无障碍功能在他们的手机上，这样他们能找到选项让应用更容易使用而不用自己翻找一堆设置菜单。每个步骤应该显示功能在用简明语言做什么和一个简单的切换，指南应该记住用户已经打开哪些这样他们能回来后来调整。

corpus_topic: App permissions audit and revoke manager
query_text: Build a mobile permissions manager app where I can see at a glance which phone apps have access to things like my camera, contacts, and location, all in one place instead of hunting through system settings. The app should let me tap any permission to see which apps have it and turn off access for specific ones right there, so I can clean up all those permissions I said yes to without really thinking about it.
query_text_zh: 做一个手机权限管理器应用，我能一眼看到哪些手机应用有权访问我的相机、联系人和位置，都在一个地方代替翻找系统设置。应用应该让我轻点任何权限来看哪些应用有它并直接关闭特定应用的访问权，这样我能清理所有那些我说同意的权限而没有真的想过它。

corpus_topic: Bluetooth device pairing and name assignment
query_text: Need a Bluetooth pairing app for my phone that shows nearby devices in a simple list, lets me tap one to connect, and then lets me give each paired device a custom nickname so I can tell them apart. The app should remember all my paired devices and show their nicknames instead of the generic device IDs, so I stop having to guess which one is my speaker and which one is my headphones every single time.
query_text_zh: 需要一个蓝牙配对应用给我的手机，显示附近的设备在一个简单列表里，让我轻点一个来连接，然后让我给每个配对的设备一个自定义昵称这样我能把它们分开。应用应该记住所有我配对的设备并显示他们的昵称代替通用设备ID，这样我停止每一次都猜测哪个是我的扬声器哪个是我的耳机。

query_text: A calendar sync setup tool for my phone that lets me connect my Google or work calendar account and choose which of those calendars I want to show up in my main calendar app, so all my events land in one place. The app should walk me through linking each account step by step and let me toggle individual calendars on or off after connecting, so I have full control over what shows up on my phone.
query_text_zh: 一个日历同步设置工具给我的手机，让我连接我的Google或工作日历账户并选择那些日历中哪个我想在我的主日历应用中显示，这样我所有的事件都进到一个地方。应用应该逐步引导我连接每个账户并让我在连接后切换单个日历开或关，这样我对什么在我的手机上显示有充分的控制。

corpus_topic: Cross-platform data import and mapping flow
query_text: Build a data import helper app for my phone that lets me bring in a file from another app or service and then match up the columns from that file to the right fields in my app, so the data lands in the correct place. The app should show me a side-by-side preview of how the imported data will look after matching, and let me correct any mismatches before confirming, so I stop ending up with names in the wrong column or dates in the wrong format.
query_text_zh: 做一个数据导入帮手应用给我的手机，让我从另一个应用或服务引入一个文件然后匹配那个文件的列到我应用中的对字段，这样数据进到正确的地方。应用应该显示我一个导入数据匹配后会看起来什么样的并排预览，并让我在确认前更正任何不匹配，这样我停止以错误列或错误格式日期结束的名字。

query_text: Create a mobile link router app that intercepts shared links on my phone and, when a link could open in more than one app, shows me a quick picker listing all the options so I can choose where it goes each time. The app should remember my preferred choices for common link types and let me update those defaults from a simple settings list, so I stop being sent to the wrong app by accident.
query_text_zh: 做一个手机链接路由器应用拦截我手机上分享的链接，当一个链接能在多于一个应用中打开时，显示给我一个快速选择器列出所有选项这样我能每次选择它去哪里。应用应该记住我对常见链接类型的偏好选择并让我从一个简单的设置列表更新那些默认，这样我停止被错误地发送到错误的应用。

query_text: Need a mobile calculator app that takes my gross monthly salary and works out my actual take-home pay, because I always forget to account for taxes and deductions and end up surprised every payday. I want to punch in my gross amount, pick my filing status and a couple of standard deduction types, and immediately see the net figure broken down so I know exactly what I am working with before I plan my budget.
query_text_zh: 需要一个手机计算器应用，能计算我的税前月薪并得出实际到手工资，因为我总是忘记扣除税费和各项扣款，导致每次发薪日都措手不及。我想输入税前收入，选择申报状态和几种标准扣除类型，然后立即看到按项目分解的净收入，这样在规划预算前我就能清楚地知道自己的真实收入。

query_text: Build a currency converter app for my phone that pulls live exchange rates so I can type in any amount in one currency and instantly see what it is worth in another, because manually looking up rates every time I travel or shop from overseas stores is a real pain. The app should let me pick from a list of major currencies, show the converted amount right away, and display when the rate was last updated so I know the number is fresh.
query_text_zh: 为手机开发一个货币兑换应用，能实时抓取汇率数据，我只需输入任意金额，就能立刻看到它用另一种货币是多少，因为每次出国旅行或从海外购物时都要手动查汇率实在太麻烦了。应用应该让我从主要货币列表中选择，立即显示转换结果，还要显示汇率的最后更新时间，这样我就能确认这个数字是最新的。

corpus_topic: Body Frame Size BMI Variant Calculator
query_text: Build a body-frame BMI calculator app for my phone that goes beyond the basic BMI number and actually adjusts the result based on whether I have a small, medium, or large frame, since standard BMI always feels off for my build. I want to enter my height, weight, and wrist circumference to figure out my frame size, and then see a BMI result that is calibrated to that frame along with a simple note on what the number means.
query_text_zh: 为手机开发一个体型调整的BMI计算应用，超越基础的BMI数字，能根据我是小骨架、中等骨架还是大骨架来调整结果，因为标准BMI对我这样的身型总是不太准确。我想输入身高、体重和腕围来判断骨架大小，然后看到根据我的骨架校准后的BMI结果，同时有一个简洁的注释说明这个数字意味着什么。

corpus_topic: Fuel Efficiency MPG to Liter Converter
query_text: Make a fuel efficiency converter app for my phone that flips between MPG and liters per 100km so I stop getting confused when I look at European car specs or rental comparisons. I want to type in either value and get the other one instantly, plus maybe a quick comparison row showing a few common benchmarks like city driving versus highway so I have some context for whether a number is actually good or not.
query_text_zh: 开发一个燃油效率转换应用让我在MPG和每百公里升数之间切换，这样我看欧洲汽车规格或租车对比时就不会再困惑。我想输入任意一个值并立即得到另一个，最好还能显示一些常见基准对比，比如城市驾驶和高速驾驶的差异，这样我就能判断一个数字是否真的不错。

query_text: Need a lumber board feet calculator app for my phone that lets me enter the thickness, width, and length of each piece of wood and instantly tells me the total board feet, because I always mess up the formula at the lumber yard and end up buying either too much or too little. It should let me add multiple pieces to a list so I can tally up a whole project order before I even get to the checkout.
query_text_zh: 需要一个手机木材板英尺计算应用，让我输入每根木料的厚度、宽度和长度，然后立即告诉我总的板英尺数，因为我在木材店总是搞不清楚公式，最后要么买太多要么买太少。应该能让我添加多个木料到列表中，这样我就能在结账前计算整个项目的订单量。

query_text: Need a road trip fuel cost estimator app for my phone that takes my trip distance, my car's fuel efficiency, and the current gas price and spits out roughly how much I should budget for gas, so I can stop guessing and actually plan my drive properly. I want to be able to swap between kilometers and miles, and maybe split the total across the number of people riding along so everyone knows their share upfront.
query_text_zh: 需要一个手机公路旅行燃油成本估算应用，输入旅行距离、汽车的燃油效率和当前汽油价格，应用就能算出我应该为汽油预算多少钱，这样我就能停止猜测并真正合理规划行程。我想能在公里和英里之间切换，最好还能把总额分摊给同行的乘客数，这样每个人都能提前知道自己的份额。

corpus_topic: Cooking Measurement US to Metric Converter
query_text: Create a cooking measurement converter app for my phone that lets me switch between US cups, tablespoons, teaspoons, and ounces on one side and grams, milliliters, and liters on the other, because following American recipes when I only have a kitchen scale is such a headache. I want a clean input where I pick the ingredient type like flour or water, enter the US amount, and get the metric equivalent right away so I can just cook.
query_text_zh: 为手机开发一个烹饪计量转换应用，让我在美式杯盎司和克数毫升升之间切换，因为按美式食谱做菜却只有厨房秤简直是噩梦。我想选择食材类型比如面粉或水，输入美式的量，然后立即得到公制的等量，这样我就能直接开始做菜了。

query_text: Build a retirement withdrawal calculator app for my phone that lets me enter my total savings, my expected annual spending, and a withdrawal rate I pick, then shows me how many years that money will last before it runs out, because I keep seeing different rules of thumb online and I just want a simple tool to check my own numbers. It should also show a year-by-year breakdown so I can see which year things start getting tight.
query_text_zh: 为手机开发一个退休提现计算应用，让我输入总储蓄、预期年度支出和我选择的提现比例，然后显示这笔钱能支撑多少年直到用完，因为我在网上看到各种不同的经验法则，我只是想有一个简单工具来验证自己的数字。应该还要显示逐年分解，这样我能看出哪一年资金开始紧张。

query_text: Create a time zone meeting scheduler tool for my phone that lets me pick a meeting time in my local time and see what hour that is in several other cities at once, because I waste so much time doing mental math and then still get it wrong when setting up calls with people in different countries. I want to add a few cities I commonly work with, set a proposed time, and instantly see whether it falls during normal working hours for everyone involved.
query_text_zh: 为手机开发一个时区会议计划工具，让我在本地时间选一个会议时间，然后同时看到那是其他几个城市的几点，因为我浪费了太多时间做心算，最后还经常算错，给不同国家的人设置电话会议的时候很麻烦。我想添加几个我常合作的城市，设定建议时间，然后立即看到这个时间是否对所有人都在正常工作时间。

query_text: Build a photo print quality calculator app for my phone that lets me enter a photo's pixel dimensions and the print size I want, then tells me the resulting DPI and whether the print will look sharp or blurry, because I keep ordering prints and ending up disappointed when the image looks soft. I want the result to clearly say something like good quality or too low so I know whether to bother printing at that size or find a higher-res version first.
query_text_zh: 为手机开发一个照片打印质量计算应用，让我输入照片的像素尺寸和我想要的打印尺寸，然后告诉我最终的DPI和打印出来是否会清晰还是模糊，因为我经常订购打印品结果却很失望，因为图像看起来很软。我想结果明确地说些像高质量或太低这样的话，这样我就能判断是否值得以那个尺寸打印还是应该先找一个更高分辨率的版本。

query_text: Need a knitting yarn estimator app for my phone that helps me figure out how many yards of yarn I need for a project, because I always either run out mid-scarf or end up with way too many leftover skeins. I want to enter the type of project like a hat, scarf, or sweater, my needle size, and my yarn weight, and get a yardage estimate along with how many skeins to buy based on the skein size I am working with.
query_text_zh: 需要一个手机毛线估算应用，帮我估计一个编织项目需要多少码的毛线，因为我总是要么在织围巾时毛线用完，要么剩下太多多余的毛线球。我想输入项目类型比如帽子围巾或毛衣，我的针号和毛线粗细，然后得到码数估计值以及根据我使用的毛线球尺寸建议买多少球。

corpus_topic: Musical BPM and Time Signature Helper
query_text: Create a BPM and time signature helper app for my phone that lets me tap a button to detect the tempo of a song I am listening to, and then shows me the note lengths in milliseconds for that BPM at whatever time signature I pick, because I always struggle to sync my loops and effects correctly when I am making music on the go. It should show the delay times for common note values like quarter notes and eighth notes so I can just copy the numbers straight into my settings.
query_text_zh: 为手机开发一个BPM和拍号助手应用，让我点击一个按钮来检测正在听的歌曲的节奏，然后在我选择的任何拍号下显示那个BPM对应的音符长度毫秒数，因为我边走边做音乐时总是难以同步我的循环和效果。应该显示常见音符值如四分音符和八分音符的延迟时间，这样我就能直接把这些数字复制到我的设置里。

query_text: Need a book reading tracker app for my phone where I can add the books I am currently reading, enter how many pages I finished today, and watch a little progress bar fill up as I get closer to the end. I like the idea of seeing my reading history laid out so I can look back at all the books I finished over the year, and it would be great if I could set a daily page goal and get a small nudge on the home screen of the app reminding me how close I am.
query_text_zh: 需要一个手机读书追踪应用，我能添加正在读的书，输入我今天读了多少页，然后看到一个小进度条随着我越来越接近完成而逐渐填满。我喜欢能看到我的阅读历史展开，这样我能回顾一整年读过的所有书，最好还能设定每日读页目标，在应用主屏幕上收到一个小提醒，告诉我离完成有多近。

query_text: Create a screen time logger app for my phone where I can manually jot down which category of app I just spent time on, like social media, games, work, or news, and roughly how many minutes I was on it, so I can get a sense of where my phone time actually goes each day. I want a simple way to tap a category, enter a duration, and then see a little daily summary showing which buckets are eating up the most of my time.
query_text_zh: 为手机开发一个屏幕时间记录应用，我能手动记录刚刚花时间在哪个应用类别比如社交媒体游戏工作或新闻，以及大概花了多少分钟，这样我能了解我的手机时间每天都去哪了。我想要一个简单的方式来点击一个类别、输入时长，然后看到一个每日总结，显示哪些类别占用了我最多的时间。

corpus_topic: Personal Finance Cash Flow Daily Log
query_text: Create a personal cash flow daily log app for my phone where I can quickly jot down money coming in and money going out throughout the day, tag each entry with a simple category like food, transport, or income, and then see a running total for the day so I always know whether I am in the green or red. I want to be able to flip through past days easily and see a simple summary at the top of the app showing my net for the current week.
query_text_zh: 为手机开发一个个人现金流日志应用，我能在整天快速记录进账和支出，给每个记录标上简单的类别比如食物交通或收入，然后看到当天的总额，这样我总是知道自己是赚是亏。我想能轻松翻看过去的日期，在应用顶部看到一个简单的总结，显示我当前一周的净额。

corpus_topic: Symptom and Medication Side Effect Journal
query_text: Need a symptom and medication side effect journal app for my phone where I can log how I feel each day alongside what medications I took, so I can actually bring useful notes to my doctor instead of trying to remember everything from the past two weeks. I want to jot down a symptom with a quick severity rating, tie it to a specific medication if I think they are related, and see a simple timeline of entries so patterns are easy to spot.
query_text_zh: 需要一个手机症状和用药副作用日记应用，我能记录我每天的感受以及我服用了什么药物，这样我就能给医生带去有用的笔记，而不是试图记起过去两周发生的一切。我想快速记下一个症状并给出简单的严重程度评分，如果我认为它们有关就关联到一种特定的药物，然后看到一个简单的时间线方便发现规律。

corpus_topic: Baby Feeding and Diaper Change Log
query_text: Build a baby feeding and diaper change log app for my phone where I can tap a big easy button whenever a feeding or diaper change happens and quickly note the time and a few details like feeding duration or diaper type, because trying to remember the last feed time when I am sleep-deprived is impossible. I want the home screen of the app to always show how many hours ago the last feeding was and a count of diaper changes for the day so I can answer the pediatrician's questions without digging through my memory.
query_text_zh: 为手机开发一个婴儿喂养和换尿布日志应用，每当发生喂养或换尿布时我能点击一个大按钮并快速记下时间和几个细节比如喂养时长或尿布类型，因为在睡眠不足的时候想起上次喂养的时间是不可能的。我想应用的主屏幕总是显示距离上次喂养过了多少小时，以及今天换尿布的次数，这样我就能回答儿科医生的问题而无需翻找记忆。

query_text: A social interaction diary app for my phone where I can write a quick note after hanging out with someone, rate how energized or drained the interaction left me on a simple scale, and log who I spent time with, so I can start noticing which relationships leave me feeling good versus which ones are always exhausting. The app should let me look back at entries by person so I can see a pattern over time for each relationship in my life.
query_text_zh: 为手机开发一个社交互动日记应用，我能在和某人一起玩耍后快速记下笔记，在一个简单的刻度上评价这次互动让我精力充沛还是精力耗尽，并记录我和谁在一起，这样我就能开始注意到哪些关系让我感觉良好，而哪些总是令人疲惫。应用应该让我按人查看记录，这样我能看到一段时间内每段关系的规律。

corpus_topic: Weather and Outfit Daily Match Log
query_text: A daily outfit and weather log app for my phone that lets me record what I wore each morning and match it to the weather that day, like temperature and whether it rained, so I can look back and figure out which outfits actually worked for which conditions. The tracker should keep a running list of past entries so I can quickly reference what I wore last time it was cold and rainy and decide whether to repeat the combo or try something different.
query_text_zh: 为手机开发一个每日穿搭和天气日志应用，让我记录每个早上穿了什么，并将其与那天的天气比如温度和是否下雨相匹配，这样我能回顾并判断哪些穿搭在什么条件下实际有效。追踪器应该保持过去记录的持续列表，这样我能快速查看上次天气冷又下雨时穿的什么，然后决定是重复这个搭配还是尝试新东西。

query_text: Need a focus session logger app for my phone where I can start a timer when I sit down to do deep work, label what I am working on, and then save the session when I am done so I can see how many focused hours I actually put in each week. I want the app to show a simple list of past sessions with the topic and duration so I can look back at a week and see whether I am being as productive as I think or just telling myself I worked a lot.
query_text_zh: 需要一个手机专注时段记录应用，我能在坐下做深度工作时启动一个计时器、标记我在做什么，然后在完成时保存这个时段，这样我就能看到我每周实际花了多少专注小时。我想应用显示一个过去时段的简单列表，带上主题和时长，这样我能回顾一周并看看我是否真的像自己想象的那样高效，还是只是告诉自己工作了很久。

query_text: Create a daily new words tracker app for my phone where I can add any new word I picked up that day in whatever language I am studying, jot down a quick example sentence, and then flip through all my saved words later to review them. I want the app to show me how many new words I have added each day so I can keep a streak going, and a simple list view where I can tap any word to see my notes and example sentence again.
query_text_zh: 为手机开发一个每日新单词追踪应用，我能添加那天学到的任何新单词，无论是什么语言，快速记下一个例句，然后稍后翻看所有保存的单词来复习。我想应用显示我每天添加了多少新单词，这样我能保持连胜记录，还要有一个简单的列表视图，我能点击任何单词看到我的笔记和例句。

query_text: Create a home chore habit log app for my phone where I can set up a list of regular chores like vacuuming, doing laundry, or cleaning the bathroom, mark each one as done when I finish it, and see which ones I have been skipping for too long. I want the app to show me the last time I did each chore so I never have to wonder whether I already mopped this week or whether it has been two weeks since I cleaned the bathroom.
query_text_zh: 为手机开发一个家务习惯日志应用，让我设定一个日常家务清单比如吸尘做洗衣或清洁卫生间，当我完成时标记它，然后看看我忽略了哪些太久。我想应用显示我上次做每项家务是什么时候，这样我永远不用想着我这周是否已经拖地了，或者是否已经两周没有清洁卫生间了。

query_text: Build a sleep quality log app for my phone where every morning I can rate how well I slept on a simple scale, add a short note about anything that might have affected my sleep like stress or late coffee, and track what time I went to bed and woke up. I want the app to show a weekly summary so I can see whether my sleep quality is trending up or down and figure out what is helping or hurting my rest over time.
query_text_zh: 为手机开发一个睡眠质量日志应用，每个早上我能在一个简单的刻度上评价我睡得多好，添加一个简短的笔记说明可能影响睡眠的因素比如压力或太晚喝咖啡，并追踪我的上床和起床时间。我想应用显示一个周总结，这样我能看到我的睡眠质量是趋势向上还是向下，并随着时间判断什么在帮助或伤害我的睡眠。

corpus_topic: Daily Step and Active Minutes Recorder
query_text: Need a daily steps and active minutes recorder app for my phone where I can manually enter my step count and how many minutes I spent moving around each day, since I do not always have my fitness tracker synced and just want a simple place to log the numbers myself. I want to see a weekly chart showing my activity so I can notice when I have had a lazy stretch and motivate myself to move more the following days.
query_text_zh: 需要一个手机每日步数和活动分钟记录应用，我能手动输入我的步数和每天花了多少分钟活动，因为我的健身追踪器不总是同步，我只是想有一个简单的地方来自己记录这些数字。我想看到一个周表图显示我的活动，这样当我有懒散的时期时我就能注意到，并在接下来的日子里激励自己多活动。

query_text: A LinkedIn connection message personalizer tool for my phone where I type in a few quick details about the person I want to connect with, like their job title, company, or something we have in common, and the app generates a short personalized message I can copy and send right away. I want a few different tone options like friendly, professional, or casual so I can pick the one that fits the situation, and the whole thing should fit comfortably on a single mobile screen so I can use it on the go.
query_text_zh: 为手机开发一个LinkedIn连接信息个性化工具，我输入一些关于我想连接的人的快速信息比如职位公司或我们的共同点，应用就生成一个简短的个性化信息我可以复制然后立即发送。我想有几个不同的语气选项比如友好专业或随意，这样我能根据情况选择合适的，整个东西应该能舒适地显示在单个手机屏幕上，这样我可以在外出时使用。

query_text: Create a thank-you note template generator app for my phone where I pick the occasion, like a gift, a favor, or a job referral, and the app gives me a few ready-made note templates I can tap through and copy. query_text_zh: 为手机开发一个感谢信模板生成应用，我选择场合比如收到礼物帮助或工作推荐，应用就给我几个现成的信模板我可以逐个查看和复制。我想能在发送前略微调整措辞，也许根据我写给谁选择温暖或正式的语气。

corpus_topic: Apology Message Builder and Tone Checker
query_text: Make a mobile app that helps me put together an apology message when I've messed up with someone, where I describe what happened and the app helps me shape it into something that sounds genuine and not defensive.
