query_text_zh: 为手机开发一个应用来帮我在和某人闹别扭时写道歉信息，我描述发生了什么事，应用帮我把它塑造成听起来真诚而不自卫的样子。应该还能快速让我感受语气是显得太冷漠还是太过头，这样我就能在发送前修复。

query_text: Make a gift recommendation tool for my phone where I answer a few quick questions about the person I'm buying for, like whether they're introverted or outgoing and what kind of things they enjoy, and it suggests a handful of gift ideas that actually match their personality. I want the suggestions to feel personal, not just generic best-sellers.
query_text_zh: 为手机开发一个礼物推荐工具，我回答几个关于我给谁买礼物的快速问题，比如他们是内向还是外向，以及喜欢什么样的东西，应用就建议一些真正符合他们个性的礼物创意。我希望这些建议感觉个人，而不只是通用的畅销品。

query_text: Need a mobile app that helps me make little introduction cards for guests at a party, where I type in each person's name and a fun fact or two and the app puts it into a neat card format people can read. It would be great if each card had a consistent look so guests can scan them quickly during the event and actually start conversations.
query_text_zh: 需要一个手机应用来帮我为派对嘉宾制作小介绍卡，我输入每个人的名字和一两个有趣的事实，应用就把它放成一个整洁的卡片格式人们可以阅读。如果每张卡都有一致的外观就太好了，这样嘉宾在活动中可以快速扫一眼，真正开始对话。

query_text: Make a long-distance friendship planner app for my phone where my friend and I can browse activity ideas we can do together even from different cities, like watching the same movie at the same time or playing a quick online game, and mark which ones we want to try. It should feel like a shared list we can both update and tap through one idea at a time.
query_text_zh: 为手机开发一个远距离友谊计划应用，我和我的朋友可以浏览即使在不同城市也能一起做的活动想法，比如同时看同一部电影或玩一个快速的网络游戏，并标记我们想尝试的。应该感觉像一个我们都能更新和逐个浏览创意的共享列表。

corpus_topic: Social Media Caption and Emoji Generator
query_text: Create a caption and emoji generator app for my phone where I type in what a photo is about, pick a vibe like funny or heartfelt, and it spits out a few caption options with matching emojis I can copy straight to my post. I want to be able to tap through different options quickly and pick the one that fits best.
query_text_zh: 为手机开发一个标题和表情符号生成应用，我输入一张照片是什么内容，选择一个氛围比如有趣或感人，应用就生成几个标题选项带着匹配的表情符号我可以直接复制到我的帖子。我想能快速逐个点击不同选项，选出最合适的。

query_text: Need a mobile app that helps me plan out a tricky conversation before I have it, where I describe the situation and what I want to say and the app helps me organize it into a clear script with an opening, the main point, and a calm way to close. It would help so much to walk in with my thoughts in order and not ramble when things get awkward.
query_text_zh: 需要一个手机应用来帮我在进行一次棘手对话前计划它，我描述情况和我想说什么，应用帮我把它组织成一个清晰的脚本，带着开场主要要点和冷静的结束方式。提前准备好自己的想法会非常有帮助，这样我不会在事情变尴尬时胡言乱语。

query_text: Build a prep kit app for my phone that helps me get ready before a networking event, where I can jot down the names and background of people I want to meet and the app organizes everything into a quick one-screen view I can glance at before walking in. It should also let me add a few talking points or questions I want to bring up so I feel confident and prepared.
query_text_zh: 为手机开发一个准备工具应用来帮我在参加网络活动前做好准备，我能记下我想见面的人的名字和背景，应用把一切组织成一个我走进去前可以瞥一眼的快速单屏视图。应该还让我添加几个我想提起的谈话要点或问题，这样我就能感到自信和有准备。

query_text: Make a holiday card message creator app for my phone where I pick the holiday and the relationship, like for a coworker or a grandparent, and the app gives me a few warm message options I can customize and copy. I want to be able to pick between a heartfelt tone and something more lighthearted so the message feels right for each person on my list.
query_text_zh: 为手机开发一个假日贺卡信息创建应用，我选择假日和关系比如同事或祖父母，应用就给我几个温暖的信息选项我可以定制和复制。我想能在感人的语气和更轻松活泼的东西之间选择，这样信息对我清单上的每个人都感觉合适。

query_text: Build a team-building activity suggester app for my phone where I enter some basics like how many people are in the group and whether we prefer indoor or outdoor stuff, and the app gives me a list of concrete activity ideas to browse one at a time. I want each suggestion to include a short description of how it works so I can pitch it to the team without having to do extra research.
query_text_zh: 为手机开发一个团队建设活动建议应用，我输入一些基本信息比如团队有多少人以及我们是否倾向于室内或室外活动，应用就给我一个具体活动创意的列表我可以逐个浏览。我希望每个建议包括它如何运作的简短描述，这样我就能向团队提议而无需做额外研究。

query_text: A countdown timer app for my phone built around the excitement of an upcoming show, concert, or event ticket, where the main screen shows a big beautiful number ticking down the days and hours in a style that feels more like a poster than a plain clock. The whole vibe should feel anticipatory and a little theatrical, with the event name and date displayed in a way I'd actually want to screenshot and share.
query_text_zh: 为手机开发一个围绕即将到来演出音乐会或活动票的兴奋感的倒计时应用，主屏幕显示一个大的漂亮数字，倒数日期和小时，风格更像是一张海报而不是普通时钟。整个氛围应该感到期待和有点戏剧性，活动名称和日期以我实际想要截图分享的方式显示。

query_text: Build a retirement countdown app for my phone that shows how many years and months I have left until I hit retirement age, with a visual feel that is calm and a little reflective rather than stressful, like soft tones and a clean layout that makes the number feel meaningful instead of alarming. I want it to feel like a gentle reminder of the chapter ahead, not a ticking clock bearing down on me.
query_text_zh: 为手机开发一个退休倒计时应用，显示我还有多少年多少个月直到达到退休年龄，视觉感觉平静而略微沉思，而不是压力重重，比如柔和的色调和干净的布局让这个数字感到有意义而不是令人惊恐。我希望它感觉像是对即将到来的人生篇章的温和提醒，而不是一个压在我身上的滴答时钟。

query_text: Create a sports season opening countdown app for my phone that counts down to the first game of the season with the kind of energy and color that actually matches the sport, so it feels exciting to open every day. I want to pick the team and sport, and have the countdown displayed in a bold, fan-worthy style with the team colors setting the whole mood.
query_text_zh: 为手机开发一个体育赛季开幕倒计时应用，倒数到赛季首场比赛，带着真正符合这项体育的能量和颜色，这样每天打开都感到令人兴奋。我想选择球队和体育运动，然后用显眼的球迷风格的时钟显示倒数，球队颜色设定整个氛围。

corpus_topic: Bar or Board Exam Prep Countdown
query_text: A study countdown app for my phone focused on bar or board exam prep, where the timer counts down to exam day and the feel is focused and serious but not so grim that it stresses me out more. I want the main screen to show days remaining in a clean, minimal style that feels like a study journal, with a small space to jot my daily intention or goal so each day feels like a step forward.
query_text_zh: 为手机开发一个专注于律师或医学考试准备的学习倒计时应用，计时器倒数到考试日期，感觉专注而严肃但不是那么令人沮丧以至于增加我的压力。我想主屏幕以干净最小的风格显示剩余天数，感觉像学习日志，有一个小空间让我记下每日意图或目标，这样每一天都感觉像一个向前的步骤。

query_text: Make a visa and immigration deadline tracker app for my phone that keeps all my important dates in one place, like application deadlines, status check dates, and renewal windows, displayed in a calm and organized way that is easy to read at a glance. I want the design to feel composed and trustworthy, like something that helps me stay on top of things rather than panic about them.
query_text_zh: 为手机开发一个签证和移民截止日期追踪应用，将我所有重要日期保持在一个地方，比如申请截止日期状态检查日期和续期时间，以平静和有组织的方式显示，易于一眼扫过。我希望设计感到稳定和值得信赖，像一个帮我掌控事情而不是对其恐慌的东西。

query_text: Build a sobriety milestone counter app for my phone that tracks clean days since a chosen start date and shows the number in a way that feels warm, personal, and worth celebrating, with milestone markers at meaningful points like 30 days, 90 days, and a year. I want the whole thing to feel like a quiet source of pride to open every morning, with a tone that is gentle and affirming.
query_text_zh: 为手机开发一个清醒里程碑计数应用，追踪自选定开始日期以来的清醒天数，并以温暖个人和值得庆祝的方式显示这个数字，在有意义的点比如30天90天和一年设置里程碑标记。我希望整个东西感觉像每个早上打开都引以为豪的安静源泉，语气温和和肯定。

query_text: Build a military deployment return countdown app for my phone where I set the expected homecoming date and the app shows the days counting down in a way that feels loving and meaningful, with a warm color palette and a place to write a short message or note to look forward to. I want the feel to be hopeful and personal, not cold or functional, since this is something you open every single day while waiting.
query_text_zh: 为手机开发一个军事部署归来倒计时应用，我设定预期的回家日期，应用显示倒数天数，方式感到充满爱和有意义，带着温暖的调色板和一个可以写下一条简短信息或笔记来期待的地方。我希望感觉充满希望和个人，而不是冷漠或功能性的，因为这是你每一天都打开等待的东西。

query_text: A lease renewal tracker app for my phone that keeps an eye on when my apartment lease is up for renewal and shows the countdown in a clean, organized way so I never get caught off guard by a deadline. query_text_zh: 为手机开发一个租约续期追踪应用，关注我的公寓租约何时到期续期，以干净有组织的方式显示倒数，这样我永远不会被截止日期措手不及。我希望设计感到整洁和家庭化，也许有点温暖，有空间记下关键日期比如我需要何时通知何时开始找公寓如果我计划搬家。

query_text: A product launch countdown app for my phone where I can set the launch date and the main screen shows a bold, exciting ticking clock with the product name and a short teaser line I write myself. The feel should be polished and shareable, something that looks like a real pre-launch page so I could screenshot it and post it, with the design conveying energy and anticipation.
query_text_zh: 为手机开发一个产品发布倒计时应用，我可以设定发布日期，主屏幕显示一个大的令人兴奋的滴答时钟，带着产品名称和我自己写的简短预告线。感觉应该是精美和可分享的，看起来像一个真实的预发布页面，我可以截图并发布，设计传达能量和期待。

query_text: Create an album or book release countdown app for my phone where I enter the release date, the title, and the artist or author, and the app counts down with a mood that matches the creative work, whether that is moody and literary or punchy and musical. I want the design to feel like a fan-made teaser page, something with personality that I would actually keep open on my phone and show to other fans who are waiting too.
query_text_zh: 为手机开发一个专辑或书籍发布倒计时应用，我输入发布日期标题和艺术家或作者，应用以与创意作品相匹配的心态倒数，无论那是沉闷文学的还是朗朗上口音乐的。我希望设计感觉像一个粉丝制作的预告页，有个性，我实际上会在手机上打开并给其他也在等待的粉丝看。

query_text: Build a space mission launch countdown app for my phone that counts down to an upcoming rocket launch with a look and feel pulled straight from mission control, think dark backgrounds, glowing countdown numbers, and that charged electric atmosphere of a real launch day. I want to enter the mission name and launch time and have the app feel genuinely epic every time I open it.
query_text_zh: 为手机开发一个太空任务发射倒计时应用，倒数到即将进行的火箭发射，带着直接从任务控制拉出的外观和感觉，想象黑色背景发光的倒数数字，以及真实发射日的充电电气氛围。我想输入任务名称和发射时间，每次打开应用都感觉真正史诗般的。

corpus_topic: Word and Character Count with Density
query_text: A word and character count tool on my phone that I can paste any text into and instantly see the total word count, character count, and a breakdown of which words show up the most, so I can check density without copying things to my laptop. I always run into the hassle of needing to verify text length and keyword repetition on the go, so a simple paste-and-see mobile tool would save me a lot of back and forth.
query_text_zh: 为手机开发一个文字和字符计数工具，我能粘贴任何文本并立即看到总词数、字符数和对哪些单词出现最频繁的分解，这样我能在不复制到笔记本电脑的情况下检查密度。我总是遇到需要验证文本长度和关键词重复的麻烦，所以一个简单的粘贴查看的手机工具会省我很多来回。

query_text: Make a duplicate line remover tool for my phone where I can paste in a messy list or block of text and the app automatically strips out any repeated lines or phrases and gives me back the cleaned-up version I can copy. I keep getting sent documents or notes with a ton of repetition and doing it manually on my phone is painful, so I just need something quick and no-fuss that handles it in one tap.
query_text_zh: 为手机开发一个重复行删除工具，我能粘贴进一个混乱的列表或文本块，应用自动删除任何重复的行或短语并给我回清理后的版本我可以复制。我经常收到有大量重复的文件或笔记，在手机上手动做这个很痛苦，所以我只需要一个快速无麻烦的工具在一次点击中处理它。

query_text: Build a text comparison tool for my phone where I paste two versions of a document or paragraph into two separate areas and the app highlights the differences between them so I can see exactly what changed. I always end up squinting at two things trying to spot edits manually and it takes forever on a phone screen, so having a highlighted diff view on mobile would cut out all that hassle.
query_text_zh: 为手机开发一个文本对比工具，我粘贴进一个文档或段落的两个版本到两个分开的区域，应用突出显示它们之间的差异，这样我能准确看到什么改变了。我总是最后在两个东西上眯眼试着手动发现编辑，在手机屏幕上花太长时间，所以在手机上有一个突出显示的差异视图会消除所有这些麻烦。

query_text: An email subject line tester app on my phone where I type in two or three subject line options and get a quick side-by-side breakdown of which one is more likely to get opened, based on things like length, tone, and word choice. I spend way too long second-guessing subject lines before hitting send, so a simple tool that tells me which version reads better would take that decision off my plate.
query_text_zh: 为手机开发一个电子邮件主题行测试应用，我输入两到三个主题行选项并得到一个快速的并排分解，说明哪一个更可能被打开，基于长度语气和措辞之类的东西。我花太多时间在发送前心理第二次猜测主题行，所以一个简单的工具告诉我哪个版本读起来更好会把那个决定从我的盘子上拿下来。

corpus_topic: JSON CSV YAML Formatter and Validator
query_text: Create a mobile tool for formatting and validating JSON, CSV, and YAML files on my phone, because I keep running into broken data files at work and I have to use my laptop just to figure out where the problem is. I want to paste in a chunk of text, tap a button to check if it's valid, and have the app highlight the exact line that's wrong so I can fix it quickly.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个手机工具来验证和格式化JSON、CSV和YAML文件，因为我经常在工作中遇到损坏的数据文件，不得不拿出笔记本来找问题所在。我想粘贴一段文本，点击按钮检查是否有效，然后app能高亮显示错误的具体行号，这样我可以快速修复。

query_text: Make a regex builder and tester tool for my phone so I can stop copy-pasting patterns into random websites every time I need to check if something matches. The app should let me type a pattern and a test string, then show me right away which parts match, with a simple plain-English hint about what the pattern does so I don't have to memorize the syntax.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个手机上的正则表达式构建和测试工具，这样就不用每次都把表达式复制粘贴到网站上去检查是否匹配了。app应该让我输入一个表达式和测试字符串，然后立即显示哪些部分匹配，还要有简单易懂的英文提示，说明这个表达式的作用，不需要我去死记语法。

query_text: Create a spell check and grammar corrector tool for mobile that I can use whenever I need to quickly clean up an email or report before sending it from my phone. I want to paste in my text, tap check, and see the mistakes highlighted so I can tap each one and pick the right fix, all on a single screen without having to scroll back and forth.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个手机上的拼写检查和语法纠正工具，在我从手机发送邮件或报告前，可以快速清理一下文本。我想粘贴文本，点击检查，然后错误会被高亮显示，我可以逐个点击选择正确的修复方案，全部在一个屏幕上完成，不用来回滚动。

query_text: Need a text summarizer and key points extractor app for my phone that saves me from reading through long articles and reports just to find the three things I actually need. I want to paste in a block of text, hit summarize, and get a short paragraph summary plus a bullet list of the main points, so I can get the gist in under a minute.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个手机应用，可以为我总结长篇文章和报告，提取关键信息，这样我就不用通读全文来找那三个真正有用的东西。我想粘贴一段文本，点击总结，得到一个简短段落总结加上一个列表式的要点列表，这样我可以在一分钟内掌握大意。

query_text: Make a secure password generator app for my phone that helps me stop reusing the same lazy passwords everywhere. I want to set the length and choose whether to include numbers, symbols, or uppercase letters, then tap a button to get a strong password I can copy instantly, with a little strength meter showing how safe it actually is.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个手机上的安全密码生成器，可以帮我改掉到处重用同一个简单密码的坏习惯。我想设置密码长度，选择是否包含数字、符号或大写字母，然后点击按钮生成一个强密码我可以直接复制，还有个小的强度指示器显示这个密码到底有多安全。

query_text: Create a markdown to HTML converter tool for my phone so I don't have to hunt down a laptop every time I want to see what my markdown actually looks like as a proper page. I want to type or paste markdown on one half of the screen, and see the formatted HTML result on the other half update as I type, with a copy button to grab the final HTML output.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个手机上的Markdown转HTML工具，这样我就不用每次都找台笔记本来看我的Markdown最后会是什么样子。我想在屏幕左边输入或粘贴Markdown，右边实时看到格式化后的HTML结果，还要有个复制按钮让我可以直接复制最终的HTML代码。

query_text: Create a readability checker app for my phone that tells me how easy my writing is to understand, using a Flesch score so I know if I'm writing too complicated for my audience. I paste in my text, tap check, and get a score with a plain label like easy, medium, or hard, plus a quick breakdown of average sentence length and word complexity so I know what to fix.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个手机应用可以检查我的文字有多易读，用Flesch评分来告诉我是不是写得太复杂了，不适合我的目标读者。我粘贴文本，点击检查，就会得到一个分数，带有简单的标签比如容易、中等或困难，还有平均句子长度和词汇复杂度的快速分解，这样我就知道要改进什么。

query_text: Need a workout exercise random picker app I can use on my phone when I show up at the gym and have no idea what to do that day. I want to pick a muscle group or workout type, tap a button, and get a randomly picked exercise with a short description of how to do it, so I always have something concrete to start with instead of standing around wasting time.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个手机上的随机选择健身动作app，当我到了健身房但不知道今天该练什么的时候可以用。我想选择一个肌肉群或者训练类型，点击按钮，app就随机选择一个动作并给出简短的说明，这样我就总有具体的东西可以开始做，不用站在那边浪费时间。

corpus_topic: Movie Genre and Film Random Selector
query_text: Make a movie picker app for my phone that randomly selects a film for me and my friends when we spend forever arguing about what to watch. I want to choose a genre first, like horror or comedy, and then tap a button that picks a specific movie from that category, showing the title and a one-line description so we can decide if we're in the mood for it.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个手机电影选择器app，当我和朋友老是争论看什么电影的时候，可以随机为我们选一部。我想先选择一个类型，比如恐怖或喜剧，然后点击按钮随机选择这个类别中的一部具体电影，显示标题和一句话描述，这样我们可以决定是否有兴致看这部。

query_text: Create a baby name generator app for my phone that randomly suggests names so my partner and I can browse through ideas without sitting at a computer for hours. I want to filter by style, like classic or modern, and maybe by origin, then tap shuffle to get a new name with a short meaning, and save the ones we like to a favorites list so we can compare later.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个手机上的婴儿名字生成器app，可以随机建议名字，这样我和我的伴侣就不用坐在电脑前花几小时来浏览名字了。我想按风格筛选，比如经典或现代，或者按出身地，然后点击随机打乱来获取新名字及其含义，还能把喜欢的保存到收藏夹，之后可以拿来比较。

query_text: Create a random color palette creator for my phone that generates brand-ready color combinations when I'm starting a new little project and have no idea where to begin with colors. I want to tap a button to get a fresh palette of four or five colors, see their hex codes so I can copy them, and lock any color I like before shuffling the rest again.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个手机上的随机配色盘生成器，当我开始一个新小项目但不知道从哪里开始选择颜色的时候可以用。我想点击按钮得到一个包含四五种颜色的新配色，看到它们的十六进制代码这样可以复制，如果我喜欢某个颜色可以锁定，然后再随机其他的。

corpus_topic: Story Prompt and Writing Idea Generator
query_text: A story prompt generator app for my phone where I can tap once and get a fresh writing idea whenever I feel stuck and have no idea what to write about next. The generator should give me a scenario with a character, a setting, and a conflict all in one short paragraph, and I can tap again to swap out just one part if the rest of the prompt is almost perfect.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个手机故事提示生成器app，当我卡住了不知道写什么的时候可以点一下就得到一个新的写作灵感。生成器应该给我一个包含角色、场景和冲突的故事梗概，全部在一个短段落中，如果其他部分都很好但有一部分不太对，我可以再点一下只更换那一部分。

query_text: Build a tournament bracket builder app for my phone that randomly sorts a list of team names into a bracket so my friends and I can run a proper competition without printing anything out. I want to type in all the team names, tap generate, and see a neat bracket drawn out on screen where I can tap to fill in winners as we go round by round.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个手机上的赛事括号生成app，可以随机把一列球队名字排成赛事括号，这样我和朋友可以办一场真正的竞赛而不用打印任何东西。我想输入所有球队名字，点击生成，然后在屏幕上看到一个整洁的赛事括号图，我可以逐轮点击来填写获胜者。

query_text: Build a trivia category picker app for my phone so my group can quickly agree on what kind of questions to do without everyone arguing for ten minutes. I want a list of categories like history, sports, science, and pop culture, and when nobody can decide, we tap a random pick button and the app chooses one for us, then shows a few starter questions in that category to kick things off.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个手机上的琐事类别选择器app，这样我们这个小组可以快速同意问什么类别的问题，不用每次都为这个争论十分钟。我想看一个类别列表，比如历史、体育、科学和流行文化，当没人能决定时我们就点一下随机选择按钮，app会为我们选一个类别，然后显示这个类别的一些起始问题。

query_text: A vacation destination roulette app for my phone where I spin a wheel and it lands on a random travel spot to help me and my friends stop going in circles every time we want to plan a trip. The app should let me add destinations to the wheel ourselves, spin it with a tap, and show the winning destination with a short blurb about why it could be fun to visit.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个手机上的度假地点轮盘app，可以转动轮盘随机选择一个旅游目的地，这样我和朋友就不用每次计划旅行时都绕圈子了。app应该让我们自己添加目的地到轮盘上，点击转动，然后显示获胜的目的地并带上一小段关于为什么这个地方值得去的描述。

corpus_topic: Random Acts of Kindness Daily Suggester
query_text: Create a daily kindness suggester app for my phone that gives me one simple good deed idea every day so I remember to actually do something nice instead of just meaning to. I want to open the app and see a fresh suggestion each day, like leaving a kind note or helping a neighbor, and be able to tap a button for a new idea if today's suggestion doesn't fit my situation.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个手机上的每日善行建议app，每天给我一个简单的善行创意，这样我才能记得真正做点好事而不只是说说而已。我想打开app看到一个新的每日建议，比如留个友善的纸条或帮助邻居，如果今天的建议不太适合我的情况，我可以点按钮换一个。

corpus_topic: Board Game Scenario and Event Generator
query_text: Need a board game event generator app for my phone that creates random scenarios and special events during our game nights so we can add some variety instead of always playing by the same basic rules. I want to pick a board game type, like strategy or party game, and tap generate to get a fun twist or event card idea, with enough detail that we can actually play it out.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个手机上的棋盘游戏事件生成器app，可以在我们游戏夜间创建随机场景和特殊事件，这样我们就不用总是按同样的基础规则玩。我想选择一个棋盘游戏类型，比如策略或派对游戏，然后点击生成得到一个有趣的变动或事件卡创意，要有足够的细节让我们真的能玩出来。

corpus_topic: Dice Roll and Coin Flip Simulator
query_text: Create a dice roll and coin flip simulator app for my phone so I always have a quick way to make random decisions and settle small arguments wherever I am, even when there are no physical dice around. I want to choose how many dice to roll and which type, like a six-sided or twenty-sided die, tap roll, and see the result clearly, with a separate coin flip button right on the same screen.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个手机上的骰子和硬币翻转模拟器app，这样我无论在哪里都能快速做随机决定和解决小纠纷，即使周围没有真实的骰子。我想选择要掷几个骰子，选择骰子类型，比如六面或二十面，然后点击掷骰子，清楚地看到结果，屏幕上还要有单独的硬币翻转按钮。

query_text: Build a mobile tool that looks at any image I upload and writes a clear text description of what is in it, so I can quickly generate alt text for images I use at work without having to think one up myself every single time. I want to pick a photo from my phone, tap describe, and get a short plain-language description I can copy and paste wherever I need it.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个手机工具，可以看我上传的任何图像，然后写出清晰的文字描述，这样我就能快速为工作中用的图片生成替代文本，不用每次都自己想一遍。我想从手机选择一张照片，点击描述，然后得到一个简短的纯文本描述，我可以复制粘贴到任何需要的地方。

corpus_topic: Live Caption Generator for Audio and Video
query_text: Create a live caption generator app for my phone that shows text captions in real time as audio or video plays, so I can follow along in noisy places or when I forget my earphones. I want to load a short audio clip or video file, tap play, and see the captions appear on screen as the sound plays, big enough to read easily on a phone without squinting.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个手机上的实时字幕生成app，可以在音频或视频播放时实时显示文字字幕，这样我在嘈杂的地方或忘记耳机时可以跟上内容。我想加载一个短音频或视频文件，点击播放，然后看到字幕在声音播放时出现在屏幕上，字体要足够大，在手机上看不用眯眼。

query_text: A mobile reading tool that lets me flip on a one-hand mode so all the important buttons and taps move to the lower part of the screen, making the whole app reachable with just my thumb when I'm on a crowded bus holding a handrail with my other hand. I want a simple toggle I can tap once to switch the layout, and it should remember my preference the next time I open it.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个手机阅读工具，可以启用单手模式，这样所有重要的按钮和点击选项都会移到屏幕下半部分，当我在拥挤的公交车上用另一只手扶扶手时，整个app都可以用拇指操作。我想要一个简单的开关，可以点一下切换布局，app应该记住我的偏好，下次打开时还是这个设置。

corpus_topic: High Contrast and Colorblind Palette Mode
query_text: Make a mobile accessibility tool with a high contrast mode and a colorblind-friendly palette option, so people who have trouble seeing certain colors can actually read the screen comfortably on their phone. I want clear toggle buttons to switch between normal, high contrast, and a few colorblind-friendly options, and the change should apply instantly across the whole app.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个手机上的无障碍工具，带有高对比度模式和色盲友好的调色板选项，这样视力有障碍或看不清某些颜色的人可以舒适地读屏幕。我想要清晰的切换按钮来在普通、高对比度和几个色盲友好选项之间切换，变化应该立即应用到整个app。

corpus_topic: Large Text and Dyslexia Friendly Font
query_text: Need a reading helper app for my phone that lets me switch to large text and a dyslexia-friendly font so I can actually get through a wall of text without my eyes giving up halfway. I want a simple reader where I can paste any article or document, then adjust the font size and switch to an easy-to-read font with wider letter spacing, all in a couple of taps.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个手机上的阅读助手app，可以切换到大字体和易读字体，这样我才能看完一大堆文字而不是看到一半眼睛就放弃了。我想要一个简单的阅读器，可以粘贴任何文章或文档，然后调整字体大小和切换到一个易读的字体，有更宽的字母间距，点击几下就可以完成。

query_text: Build a voice-controlled navigation map app for my phone that lets me say a place name out loud and immediately shows me the route, so I can keep my eyes on the road and my hands free instead of poking at a tiny screen while trying to drive. I want it to listen for my voice, pull up the destination on a map, and read the turn-by-turn directions back to me as I go.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个手机上的语音控制导航地图app，可以让我说出地点名字就立即显示路线，这样我可以保持眼睛盯着路面，双手自由，而不用在开车时戳一个小屏幕。我想app听我的语音，在地图上显示目的地，然后在我行驶时用语音为我读出转弯方向。

query_text: Build a mobile app that uses my phone camera to track where I am looking on the screen and moves the cursor accordingly, so someone who has trouble using their hands can still tap buttons and navigate just by looking at what they want to select. I want a setup screen to calibrate the eye-tracking for my face, then a clear on-screen cursor that follows my gaze and confirms a tap when I hold my stare on something for a second.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个手机app，可以用我的手机摄像头追踪我在屏幕上看着哪里，然后相应地移动光标，这样手部有障碍的人也能通过看着想选择的东西来点击按钮和导航。我想要一个设置屏幕来为我的脸部校准眼动追踪，然后一个清楚的屏幕光标可以跟随我的目光，当我在某个东西上凝视一秒钟时确认点击。

query_text: Create a tremor filter touch stabilizer setting tool for my phone that saves me from accidentally tapping the wrong thing every time my hands shake a little. I want to set how much wobble gets filtered out before a tap registers, and the app should let me test it on a small practice area so I can tune the sensitivity until it actually feels right for my hands.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个手机上的颤抖过滤触屏稳定工具，这样当我的手有点抖动时就不会意外点错东西。我想设置要过滤掉多少颤抖才能让点击生效，app应该让我在一个小练习区测试这个，这样我可以调整灵敏度直到对我的手感来说效果刚刚好。

query_text: A sign language webcam interpreter tool for mobile where I can point my phone camera at someone signing and get a text translation right on screen, so I stop having to ask people to repeat themselves or type things out. The app should show the recognized signs as words or short phrases in real time, and let me tap to copy the translated text if I need to paste it somewhere else.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个手机上的手语摄像头翻译工具，可以对着某人打手语的时候用手机摄像头指向他们，然后在屏幕上实时看到文字翻译，这样我就不用总是让人重复或输入内容了。app应该实时显示识别的手语作为单词或短语，我可以点击复制翻译文本，如果需要粘贴到其他地方的话。

query_text: Need a simplified vocabulary reading mode app for my phone that takes any article or text I paste in and swaps out the complicated words for simpler everyday ones so I can actually get through it without stopping every few sentences to look things up. The app should highlight which words it changed so I can still learn them, and let me adjust how aggressively it simplifies the language.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个手机上的简化词汇阅读模式app，可以把我粘贴的任何文章或文本中的复杂单词换成更简单的日常单词，这样我就不用每隔几句话就停下来查字典了。app应该高亮显示它改了哪些词，这样我还是可以学到它们，还能让我调整简化语言的激进程度。

query_text: Build a predictive AAC symbol communication board app for mobile where someone who has trouble speaking can tap picture symbols to form sentences, and the app guesses the next symbol they probably want based on what they already tapped so they spend less time hunting through pages of options. The home screen should show the most-used symbols front and center, and each sentence can be read aloud with a tap.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个手机上的预测式AAC符号通讯板app，对于说话有困难的人，可以点击图片符号来组成句子，app会根据他们已经点击的内容猜测他们下一个可能想要的符号，这样他们花的时间就更少，不用翻遍一堆选项页。主屏应该显示最常用的符号在最醒目的位置，每个句子都可以点击用语音读出来。

query_text: Make a pill and capsule photo identifier app for my phone where I can take a quick photo of any tablet or capsule I find and get back basic info like what it probably is, the common name, and what color or shape it matches. I just want something lightweight I can use on the spot when I find a loose pill somewhere and have no idea what it is, with a clear result on one screen.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个手机上的药片和胶囊照片识别app，我可以快速拍一张任何药片或胶囊的照片，然后获得基本信息比如它可能是什么、常用名和它的颜色或形状匹配。我只是想要一个轻量级的东西，可以在我发现一个不知道是什么的散装药片时马上用，一个屏幕就显示清楚的结果。

query_text: Create a dream journal and symbol glossary app for my phone where I can quickly jot down a dream right after waking up, and the app keeps a personal glossary of recurring symbols I notice across my entries so I can tap any symbol and see all the dreams where it showed up. I want each journal entry to have a date, a short title, and a free-text area, and the glossary should grow as I add notes about what each symbol seems to mean.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个手机上的梦境日记和符号词汇表app，可以在我醒来后快速记下梦境，app会保存一个我在日记条目中注意到的重复出现符号的个人词汇表，这样我可以点击任何符号看所有包含它的梦。每个日记条目应该有日期、简短标题和自由文本区域，词汇表应该随着我添加关于每个符号含义的笔记而增长。

query_text: Build a geocache location field logger app for my phone where I can log each cache I find out in the field with the GPS coordinates, a quick note about where it was hidden, and whether I found it or not. The app should keep a running list of all my logged caches sorted by date, and let me tap any entry to review the details and add a follow-up note later when I get home.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个手机上的地理缓存位置野外记录app，可以用GPS坐标、快速的位置隐藏说明和是否找到的标记来记录我找到的每一个地理缓存。app应该保存一个按日期排序的所有记录缓存的列表，我可以点击任何条目查看细节，回家后还能添加补充笔记。

query_text: Make a plant disease photo diagnoser app for my phone where I can snap a picture of a sick-looking leaf or stem and get back a short description of what disease or pest it might be, along with a simple suggestion for what to do about it. I just want a clean single-tap result screen with the disease name, a brief explanation, and maybe a confidence level so I know how reliable the guess is.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个手机上的植物病害照片诊断app，可以拍一张生病看起来的叶子或茎的照片，然后看到关于它可能是什么病害或虫害的简短描述，还有简单的应对建议。我只是想要一个干净的单点结果屏幕，显示病害名称、简短解释和也许一个置信度，这样我知道这个猜测有多可靠。

query_text: Build a home Wi-Fi speed tester tool as a mobile app I can open on my phone and tap once to run a quick speed test, showing me the download speed, upload speed, and ping all on one screen. I also want it to save a history of past tests with timestamps so I can compare results over a few days and figure out whether my internet is consistently slow or just occasionally drops.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个手机app形式的家庭Wi-Fi速度测试工具，我可以在手机上打开，点一次就运行一个快速测试，显示下载速度、上传速度和延迟全部在一个屏幕上。我还想它保存一个带时间戳的过去测试的历史记录，这样我可以比较几天内的结果，搞清楚我的网络是一直很慢还是只是有时掉线。

query_text: Build an ambient noise level meter app for my phone that uses the microphone to show the current dB reading in real time on a big easy-to-read number, so I can check how loud a place is before deciding whether to stay or move somewhere quieter. I also want it to log the highest reading during each session and let me label and save sessions so I can compare different spots over time.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个手机上的环境噪声级别计量app，用麦克风实时显示当前分贝读数在一个大的易读数字上，这样我可以在决定留下或去更安静的地方之前检查一个地方有多吵。我还想它记录每个会话期间的最高读数，让我给会话标记和保存，这样我可以随着时间比较不同的位置。

query_text: Need a star gazing constellation finder app for my phone that uses my location and the current time to show me which constellations are visible tonight, and lets me tap on any one to see its name and a simple connect-the-dots outline so I know what to look for in the sky. I want it to work offline once I load it so I can use it out in the dark away from Wi-Fi.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个手机上的观星星座查找app，可以根据我的位置和当前时间告诉我今晚可以看到哪些星座，我可以点击任何一个看它的名称和简单的连线描述，这样我知道要在天空中找什么。我想让它在我加载后可以离线工作，这样在没有Wi-Fi的黑暗环境中我也能用它。

query_text: A QR code business card generator tool for mobile where I fill in my name, phone number, email, and maybe a short title, and the app instantly turns all that into a scannable QR code I can show people directly from my phone screen. The app should also let me save a few different versions, like a personal one and a work one, so I can switch between them quickly when needed.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个手机上的二维码名片生成器工具，我填入我的名字、电话、邮箱和也许一个简短的职位，app立即把所有这些转换成一个可扫描的二维码，我可以直接在我的手机屏幕上给人显示。app还应该让我保存几个不同版本，比如个人版和工作版，这样当需要时我可以快速在它们之间切换。

corpus_topic: USB Cable and Port Type Identifier
query_text: Make a USB cable and port type identifier app for my phone where I can pick from a visual list of connector shapes and get a clear explanation of what each one is, what devices use it, and whether it supports charging or data transfer. I always mix up which end goes where and I want something I can glance at on my phone in seconds instead of searching the web every single time.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个手机上的USB电缆和端口类型识别app，可以从一个视觉连接器形状列表中选择，然后获得每一个是什么、什么设备使用它和它是否支持充电或数据传输的清楚解释。我总是搞混哪一端应该进去，我想要一个东西可以在手机上快速看一眼，而不是每次都搜索网络。

corpus_topic: Car VIN Decoder and History Lookup
query_text: Need a car VIN decoder and history lookup tool as a mobile app where I can type in a 17-character VIN and get back the basic decoded info like the make, model, year, and country of manufacture all in one clean view on my phone. It would be great if the app also flags any common recall notices tied to that vehicle type so I know what to watch out for before I consider buying.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个手机app形式的汽车VIN解码和历史查询工具，可以输入一个17字符VIN然后获得基本解码信息，比如制造商、型号、年份和制造国家，全部在我手机上的一个干净视图中。如果app还能标记与这个车型相关的任何常见召回通知就太好了，这样我在考虑购买前就知道要留意什么。

query_text: Make a local sunrise and sunset clock app for my phone that shows me today's exact sunrise and sunset times based on where I am, plus a simple visual timeline of the day so I can see at a glance how much daylight is left. I want it to update automatically when my location changes, and also show tomorrow's times so I can plan early-morning or evening outdoor activities without guessing.

query_text: Make a creative writing daily word count tracker for my phone where I can log how many words I wrote each day toward my target, set a personal daily goal like 500 or 1000 words, and see a simple calendar filled in for each day I hit my goal, with a running total showing how many words I have written overall since I started.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个创意写作日字数追踪应用，在手机上我可以记录每天的写作字数，设定个人的日目标比如500或1000字，还要显示一个简单的日历，我每达成日目标的那天就填满，上面还有一个运行总计显示我从开始到现在一共写了多少字。

corpus_topic: Class schedule and module calendar view
corpus_l2_key: ④ 课程目录/课堂界面
query_text: Build a class schedule and calendar planner for my phone that lets me add all my courses with the meeting times and location, shows each week laid out so I can see which days are packed and which are free, and lets me tap on any class to see the details and any notes I have added, so I always know what is coming up for the week.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个课程表和日历计划应用，在手机上让我添加所有课程的上课时间和地点，以周为单位显示日程安排，这样我能看到哪些天课程多、哪些天比较空闲，我还要能点击某门课看课程详情和我添加的笔记，这样我总是知道本周有什么课程。

corpus_l2_key: ④ 课程目录/课堂界面
query_text: Build an online university course catalog browser for my phone where I can scroll through available courses sorted by subject, tap on any course to read the full description and see things like credit hours and prerequisites, and save the ones I am interested in to a personal list so I can compare them and decide which ones to sign up for.
query_text_zh: 帮我开发一个在线大学课程目录浏览应用，在手机上我可以按科目浏览可选的课程，点击任何课程看详细描述和学分数、前置条件等信息，我还要能把感兴趣的课程保存到个人列表，这样我能对比不同课程，最后决定要选哪些。

corpus_l2_key: ④ 课程目录/课堂界面

query_text_zh: 我想要一个移动应用显示完整的K-12科目课程地图，在手机上我能看到所有核心科目和各个年级排列在一起，我可以点进某个年级看那一年覆盖的话题，数学、科学和语言艺术等科目要用不同颜色区分，这样我一眼就能区分。

query_text_zh: 我需要一个编程训练营追踪应用，在手机上我能看到项目中每个模块和学习路线的全景，我能清楚地看到哪些模块完成了、哪些正在进行、哪些还没开始，每条学习路线还要按顺序列出，这样我不会出现课程顺序混乱的情况。

query_text_zh: 我想要一个专业认证规划应用，在手机上显示从初级到最后考试的完整学习路径，用清晰的顺序显示我需要完成的每一步，我可以完成后就勾选掉，还要有一个地方显示每个阶段的预计时间，这样我能更好地安排自己的时间。

corpus_l2_key: ④ 课程目录/课堂界面

corpus_l2_key: ④ 课程目录/课堂界面

query_text_zh: 我需要一个音乐学校课程安排规划应用，在手机上整周显示所有课程时段，学生和家长可以一眼看到每天都有什么课，我还要能按乐器类型筛选，看到每节课的老师名字，在不同周之间切换时界面要整洁更新。

corpus_l2_key: ④ 课程目录/课堂界面

query_text_zh: 我想要一个健身工作室课表应用，在手机上显示整周所有开课的课程，会员能快速找到符合自己日程的课程，每个课程条目要显示课程名、开始时间、时长和教练名字，会员还要能点击课程看短描述和还有多少个位置。

corpus_l2_key: ④ 课程目录/课堂界面
query_text: Need a corporate training catalog tool for my phone where employees can browse all the available training courses the company offers. corpus_l2_key: ④ 课程目录/课堂界面

query_text_zh: 我想要一个职业技能目录应用，在手机上列出电工、水管工、木工和焊工等所有主要行业，这样工人可以浏览每个行业包括的技能，每个行业要能展开显示具体的技能和任务，上面还要有一个搜索框，我能快速通过输入关键词找到某个技能。

corpus_l2_key: ④ 课程目录/课堂界面
query_text: Make a STEM enrichment explorer app for my phone that lets kids and parents browse all the available modules across science, technology, engineering, and math. query_text_zh: 帮我开发一个STEM教育探索应用，在手机上孩子和家长能浏览科学、技术、工程和数学各个领域的所有可用模块，每个模块要显示标题、对这个模块做什么的简短描述、推荐年龄段和初级还是进阶，这样家长和孩子能选到适合的模块而不用猜。

query_text: Need a road sign reference tool for my phone so I stop having to search online every time I forget what a sign means. query_text_zh: 我需要一个道路标志参考工具应用，在手机上这样我就不用每次忘记标志意思都要上网查，应用应该是个快速查询的地方，我能按标志类别浏览，比如警告标志和规制标志，点击任何标志能看到它的名字和用简明白话解释的意思、驾驶员看到它时该怎么做。

corpus_topic: Physics Constants and Formula Quick Sheet
query_text: Build a physics constants and formula reference app for my phone so I can stop hunting through my textbook every time I need a value or formula during studying. I want all the major constants listed with their symbols and units, plus the common formulas organized by topic like motion, energy, and electricity, so I can find what I need in seconds.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个物理常数和公式参考应用，在手机上这样我复习时就不用总是翻教科书找数值或公式，应用要列出所有主要常数和它们的符号及单位，还要按话题组织常见公式比如运动、能量和电学，这样我能在几秒钟内找到需要的东西。

query_text: Create a chemical periodic element reference app for my phone that gives me everything I need to know about any element without having to dig through a chemistry textbook. Each element should show its symbol, atomic number, atomic mass, and basic properties, and I want a search bar so I can pull up any element by name or symbol right away.
query_text_zh: 帮我开发一个化学元素周期表参考应用，在手机上不用翻阅化学教科书我就能获得任何元素的所有信息，每个元素要显示元素符号、原子序数、原子质量和基本性质，我还要一个搜索栏能通过名字或符号迅速查任何元素。

query_text: Build a grammar and punctuation rules reference app for my phone so I can stop second-guessing myself every time I write something important. I want the rules organized into clear sections like comma usage, apostrophes, and sentence structure, with short plain-English explanations and one or two simple examples for each rule so it actually makes sense.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个语法和标点符号规则参考应用，在手机上这样我写重要文字时就不用老是纠结，应用要把规则分成清晰的章节比如逗号用法、撇号和句子结构，每条规则附加简洁的英文说明和一两个简单的例子，这样规则真的能让人理解。

query_text: A cooking temperature and time reference tool for my phone that I can check in the kitchen whenever I need to know how long something should cook or at what heat. The app should cover common foods like chicken, beef, fish, and vegetables, and let me tap any food to see the right internal temperature and rough cooking time so I stop guessing and overcooking things.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个烹饪温度和时间参考工具应用，在手机上我在厨房烹饪时需要知道某样东西要烤多久或用什么温度时就能查，应用要覆盖鸡肉、牛肉、鱼和蔬菜等常见食材，点击任何食材能看到合适的内部温度和大概的烹饪时间，这样我就不用乱猜和把东西烤过头了。

query_text: A drug interaction reference tool for my phone that helps me quickly check whether two medications are safe to take together, because right now I have no easy way to do that without calling a pharmacy. The app should let me pick two drugs from a list and show a clear result explaining whether there is a known interaction and how serious it is, so I always know what to watch out for.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个药物相互作用参考工具应用，在手机上我能快速查两种药能不能一起安全服用，因为现在我没有简单的办法查这个除了打电话问药房，应用让我从列表里选两种药然后清晰地显示结果，说明是否存在已知的相互作用以及严重程度，这样我就总能知道要注意什么。

corpus_topic: Tax Bracket and Rate Calculator Sheet
query_text: Build a tax bracket and income calculator for my phone so I can stop stressing about whether I am in the right bracket and just check it quickly whenever I need to. I want to enter my income and filing status and see which bracket applies to me, plus a breakdown of how much tax applies at each rate so the whole thing is actually clear instead of confusing.
query_text_zh: 帮我开发一个所得税等级和收入计算器应用，在手机上我就不用为自己是不是在正确的税等级而担心，需要时能快速查一下，我输入收入和申报身份后能看到适用我的税等级，还有每个税率段的税金分解，这样整个计算就清楚了而不是令人困惑。

query_text: Make a musical key signature reference app for my phone that shows all the major and minor keys with their sharps and flats so I can look them up fast during practice. Each key should display the key signature, list which notes are sharp or flat, and show the relative major or minor, because right now I have to search online every time I forget and that breaks my practice flow.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个音乐调号参考应用，在手机上显示所有大调和小调及其升降号，这样我练习时能快速查到，每个调号要显示该调的升降号表、哪些音是升号或降号、相对大小调，因为现在我每次忘记都要上网搜，搜索会打断我的练习。

corpus_topic: Legal Latin Terms and Phrases Index
query_text: Need a legal Latin terms index for my phone that lets me look up any phrase I come across in a legal document and get a plain-English explanation right away. I want the terms listed alphabetically so I can browse or search, and each entry should give the Latin phrase, a simple definition, and maybe a short note on where it is commonly used, so I actually understand what I am reading.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个法律拉丁术语索引应用，在手机上让我查任何在法律文件中遇到的短语并立即得到白话英文解释，术语要按字母表排列这样我能浏览或搜索，每个条目应该给出拉丁短语、简单定义，也许还有一个简短说明这个术语通常在哪里用，这样我真的能理解自己在读什么。

corpus_topic: Sports Rules and Penalty Reference Card
query_text: Build a sports rules and penalty reference app for my phone so my friends and I can settle arguments about the rules during games without everyone shouting different things. I want it to cover several sports like soccer, basketball, and football, and for each sport there should be a list of common rules and penalties with short clear explanations so anyone can read it and understand.
query_text_zh: 帮我开发一个体育规则和处罚参考应用，在手机上这样我和朋友打比赛时能解决关于规则的争论而不用大家都在那儿吵，应用要覆盖足球、篮球和美式橄榄球等多个运动项目，每个运动都要列出常见的规则和处罚还有简洁清晰的解释，这样任何人读了都能理解。

corpus_topic: Stock Market Technical Indicator Cheat Sheet
query_text: Make a stock market technical indicator reference app for my phone that lists the most common indicators like RSI, MACD, and moving averages with a plain-language explanation of what each one measures and how traders use it. I keep forgetting what the signals mean when I am looking at a chart, so I need something I can open fast on my phone and get a clear answer without wading through long articles.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个股票市场技术指标参考应用，在手机上列出RSI、MACD和移动平均线等最常见的指标，用简明白话解释每个指标衡量什么以及交易者怎么用，我看图表时总是忘记这些信号的意思，所以我需要个能在手机上快速打开、得到清楚答案的东西，不用花时间翻冗长的文章。

corpus_l2_key: ① 待办清单/任务管理

query_text_zh: 我需要一个手机版的周回顾和规划应用，帮助我回顾实际完成了什么、记录哪些事情出错了、然后列出下周的关键任务。应用应该有简单的两部分布局，一部分用于回顾刚过去的一周，另一部分用于规划下一周，这样我就不用把所有事情都装在脑子里，而是真正有一个计划。

corpus_topic: GTD Inbox Capture and Process Flow
corpus_l2_key: ① 待办清单/任务管理
query_text: Make a quick-capture and sort-out app for my phone where I can dump every random thing on my mind into one inbox with a single tap, then go through each item and decide what to do with it, like turn it into a task, move it to a someday list, or just delete it. I hate having half my brain taken up by stuff I might forget, so I need a really fast way to get thoughts out of my head and decide where they belong.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个手机版的快速捕获和整理应用，只需轻点一下就能将脑子里的每一个随机想法倒入一个收件箱，然后逐个检查每一项，决定把它变成任务、移到待办清单还是删除。我讨厌用一半的脑力去记忆可能会忘记的东西，所以我需要一个非常快速的方式从脑子里取出想法并决定它们应该放在哪里。

corpus_l2_key: ① 待办清单/任务管理
query_text: Build a legal case action steps manager app for my phone that lets me track every step I need to take for each case I am handling, set deadlines for each action, and mark things done as I go. I want to be able to group the steps under each case name so when I am in a meeting I can pull up my phone and instantly see what still needs to happen and when, instead of trying to remember everything or hunting through my notes.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个手机版的法律案件行动步骤管理应用，可以追踪我为每个正在处理的案件需要采取的每一步，为每个行动设置截止日期，并标记完成的项目。我希望能够在每个案件名称下对步骤进行分组，这样在会议中我可以拿起手机立即看到还需要做什么以及何时完成，而不是试图记住一切或翻阅笔记。

query_text: A 5-minute sprint timer app for my phone that you just open and hit start, no setup needed, and it counts down a tight five-minute burst with a loud alert at the end. I want a big clear countdown number on screen so I can glance at it from across my desk, and maybe a counter that tracks how many sprints I have done today, because sometimes all I need is to trick myself into starting for just five minutes.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个手机版的五分钟冲刺计时器应用，只需打开并按开始就行，无需任何设置，它会倒计时五分钟并在结束时发出大声警报。我希望屏幕上显示一个大的清晰的倒计时数字，这样我可以从办公桌对面一目了然地看到时间，还可能有一个计数器追踪我今天完成了多少个冲刺，因为有时我只需要欺骗自己开始五分钟。

corpus_topic: Home screen timer widget with quick start
query_text: Build a focus timer app for my phone where the main screen shows a big start button and a countdown so I can kick off a timed work session in one tap without having to dig through settings first. I want to be able to set a custom length before I start, and have it buzz my phone when time is up, because half the time I waste ten minutes just deciding whether to start and I need something that removes all the friction.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个手机版的专注计时器应用，主屏幕显示一个大的开始按钮和倒计时，这样我可以一键启动工作计时，无需先翻过繁琐的设置。我想要在开始前能够设置自定义时长，并在时间到时让手机嗡鸣，因为我经常浪费十分钟来决定是否开始，所以我需要一个能消除一切摩擦的应用。

query_text: Build a 25/5 focus timer app for my phone that runs a 25-minute work block and then automatically switches to a 5-minute rest, then goes back to work, cycling through until I stop it. I want a big countdown showing which phase I am in, work or rest, and a small counter showing how many rounds I have done in one sitting, because I keep losing track of how long I have been working and this would help me pace myself.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个手机版的25/5专注计时器应用，运行25分钟的工作时段，然后自动切换到5分钟的休息，再回到工作，循环往复直到我停止它。我希望大的倒计时显示我正在哪个阶段（工作或休息），还有一个小的计数器显示我在一个工作周期中完成了多少轮，因为我总是失去对工作时长的追踪，这样会帮我更好地安排进度。

query_text: A 90-minute deep focus timer app for my phone with a clean full-screen countdown and nothing else showing, so I can lock in and stop checking the time every few minutes. The timer should buzz or ring at the end, and ideally it should be possible to type in a short note about what I am working on before starting so I remember why I sat down in the first place. For me this is purely about carving out a real long block of focused time and actually sticking to it.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个手机版的90分钟深度专注计时器应用，有一个干净的全屏倒计时，不显示其他任何东西，这样我可以专注工作而不会每隔几分钟就看一次时间。计时器在结束时应该发出嗡鸣或铃声，理想情况下应该可以在开始前输入一个关于我在做什么的简短笔记，这样我能记住自己为什么坐下来开始工作。对我来说这纯粹是为了开辟一个真正长的专注时间块并坚持下去。

query_text: Make a study subject rotation app for my phone that lets me add all the subjects I am studying, set a time for each one, and then cycle through them automatically so I spend equal time on each and actually review everything instead of getting stuck on one subject all evening. I want it to show me which subject is up now and which comes next, with a buzzer between each switch, because I always end up spending two hours on the same topic and ignoring the rest.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个手机版的学科轮换应用，可以添加我正在学习的所有科目，为每一个设置时间，然后自动在它们之间循环，这样我可以在每一科花相等的时间并真正复习所有内容，而不是被困在一个科目上整个晚上。我希望它显示现在轮到哪个科目以及下一个是什么，每次切换时有嗡鸣声，因为我总是花两个小时在同一个主题上而忽视其他的。

query_text: Build a pair work rotation timer app for my phone that tracks two people taking turns on a shared task, counts down each person's turn, and then rings to signal the switch. I want it to show each person's name and how much time they have left in their current turn, with a clear sound when it is time to swap, because right now we just guess and one person always ends up doing most of the hands-on work without realizing it.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个手机版的配对工作轮换计时器应用，追踪两个人在共享任务中轮流进行，倒计时每个人的时间，然后发出铃声来表示轮换。我希望它显示每个人的名字以及他们当前轮次还剩多少时间，轮换时有清晰的声音提示，因为现在我们只是猜测，一个人总是最终做了大部分实际工作而没有意识到。

query_text: Make a meeting time keeper app for my phone that lets me enter how long the whole meeting should run and set a time limit for each person's turn to speak, then counts down visibly so everyone can see how much time is left. I want a one-tap way to move to the next person and a clear warning when we are running over, because our remote team calls always go way over time and nobody wants to be the one to say something.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个手机版的会议时间管理应用，可以输入整个会议应该运行多长时间，为每个人的发言设置时间限制，然后可见地倒计时这样每个人都能看到还剩多少时间。我需要一个单击方式来切换到下一个人，以及当我们超时时有清晰的警告，因为我们的远程团队电话总是大大超时，没人想主动说什么。

query_text: Create a 10-minute language drill timer app for my phone that I can use for short focused practice sessions, where I tap start and it counts down exactly 10 minutes with a gentle buzz at the end. I want to be able to type in which language or topic I am drilling before I start, and see a log of past sessions so I can tell whether I am actually keeping up my daily practice or just telling myself I am.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个手机版的10分钟语言练习计时器应用，可以用于短的专注练习课程，我轻点开始后它倒计时正好10分钟，最后有轻柔的嗡鸣声。我希望能在开始前输入我在练习哪种语言或主题，并且能看到过去课程的日志，这样我可以判断我是否真的在坚持每日练习还是只是自己骗自己。

query_text: Need a work break reminder app for my phone that nudges me to stop and rest at regular intervals throughout the day, like every hour or so, and suggests a quick thing to do on each break such as stretch, drink water, or step away from my screen for a bit. I want to be able to set the interval myself and have it actually buzz my phone even when the screen is locked, because I routinely work straight through for four hours and feel terrible afterward.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个手机版的工作休息提醒应用，在我整天工作时定期（比如每小时）推送提醒让我休息，并建议每次休息时做一些简单的事情，比如拉伸、喝水或远离屏幕一会。我想要能自己设置间隔，并且即使屏幕锁定也能真正嗡鸣我的手机，因为我经常不间断地工作四个小时然后感觉很糟糕。

query_text: Create a classroom activity timer app for my phone that lets a teacher set the time for each part of a lesson, like group work, discussion, or solo reading, then countdown each activity and ring when it is time to move on. I want a big visible countdown so students in the back can see it too, and a way to tap to the next activity without having to retype everything, because constantly looking at my watch mid-lesson breaks the flow for everyone.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个手机版的教室活动计时器应用，可以让老师为课程的每个部分（如小组工作、讨论或独立阅读）设置时间，然后倒计时每个活动，时间到时发出铃声。我需要一个大的可见倒计时这样后排的学生也能看到，并且可以轻点切换到下一个活动，无需重新输入所有内容，因为在课堂中经常看手表会打破整个节奏。

query_text: Need a yearly roadmap planner app for my phone where I can lay out my main goals across the whole year, break them down into quarters, and add specific milestones under each one. I want to see all twelve months at a glance on one screen so I can spot when things pile up, and tap into any month to see the details. Having everything mapped out on my phone instead of scattered across notebooks would make me feel so much more on top of things.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个手机版的年度路线图规划应用，可以在整个年度内布局我的主要目标，分解成季度，并在每个目标下添加具体的里程碑。我想要在一个屏幕上一目了然地看到所有十二个月，这样我可以发现什么时候事情堆积，并轻点进入任何月份查看细节。把所有事情都映射到我的手机上而不是散落在各个笔记本中，会让我感到更有掌控感。

query_text: Build a team availability planner app for my phone that makes it easy for everyone to mark when they are free each week so we can figure out the best time for our daily stand-up without going back and forth in chat. I want each person to tap their free slots on a simple grid, and then the app shows which times overlap for the whole group, because right now scheduling even a 15-minute check-in turns into a whole conversation that takes longer than the meeting itself.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个手机版的团队可用性规划应用，让每个人都能轻松标记他们每周何时有空，这样我们可以找到每日站会的最佳时间，而无需在聊天中来回反复。我希望每个人轻点一个简单网格上的空闲时段，然后应用显示整个团队哪些时间重叠，因为现在只是调度一个15分钟的检查会都会变成一整场对话，耗时甚至超过会议本身。

query_text: Make a personal weekly schedule planner app for my phone where I can lay out my whole week day by day, add time blocks for work, errands, exercise, and whatever else I need to fit in, and check things off as the day goes. I want to be able to plan Monday through Sunday in one place and see the whole week at a glance, because I keep double-booking myself or forgetting things I said I would do and then scrambling to catch up.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个手机版的个人周计划应用，可以逐天规划我的整周，为工作、差事、锻炼和其他需要安排的事情添加时间块，并在进行过程中打勾确认。我想要在一个地方规划周一到周日并一目了然地看整个周的情况，因为我经常自己重复预订或忘记我答应做的事情，然后慌张地追赶进度。

query_text: Need a conference schedule app for my phone that lets me enter all the sessions and events for a conference or event day, see them in a clear time-ordered list, and tap each one to see the details like location and speaker. I want to be able to star the sessions I plan to attend and get a reminder a few minutes before each one starts, because I always end up missing something I wanted to see because I was too busy talking to someone.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个手机版的会议日程应用，可以输入会议或活动日的所有课程和事件，在清晰的时间顺序列表中看到它们，轻点每一个查看细节如地点和演讲者。我想要能标星我计划参加的课程，并在每一个开始前几分钟收到提醒，因为我总是最终因为太忙于和别人交谈而错过我想看的东西。

query_text: Need an academic semester calendar app for my phone where I can enter all my classes, assignment due dates, and exam dates for the whole semester and see them laid out month by month. I want to tap on any day to see what is due and be able to add notes like which chapters to review, because every semester I lose track of deadlines until they sneak up on me and then I am pulling all-nighters that could have been avoided.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个手机版的学期学术日历应用，可以输入整个学期的所有课程、作业截止日期和考试日期，并按月份显示它们。我想要轻点任何一天查看有什么截止，并能添加笔记如需要复习哪些章节，因为每个学期我都会失去截止日期的追踪直到它们突然逼近，然后我在拉通宵本可以避免的情况下。

query_text: A sprint and release cycle planner app for my phone that shows all the current sprints laid out on a timeline with their start and end dates, what is supposed to ship in each one, and a simple indicator of whether each sprint is on track, late, or done. I want to be able to scroll through past and upcoming sprints in one place on my phone so when someone asks about a release date I can just check quickly instead of having to find my laptop.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个手机版的冲刺和发布周期规划应用，显示所有当前冲刺在时间线上的布局，包括它们的开始和结束日期、每个冲刺计划发布什么内容，以及是否按计划、延迟或已完成的简单指示。我想要在一个地方在我的手机上浏览过去和即将来临的冲刺，这样当有人问发布日期时我可以快速查看而不是非得打开笔记本。

query_text: A healthcare appointment tracker app for my phone where I can add every upcoming doctor, dentist, or specialist visit with the date, time, clinic name, and any prep notes I need to remember, then see them all sorted by date in a list. I want a reminder the day before each appointment, because I keep mixing up dates or forgetting what I was supposed to bring, and missing a medical appointment is not something I want to do.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个手机版的医疗预约追踪应用，可以添加每个即将到来的医生、牙医或专家就诊预约，包括日期、时间、诊所名称和需要记住的任何准备笔记，然后在列表中按日期排序查看所有内容。我想要在每个预约前一天收到提醒，因为我经常混淆日期或忘记需要带什么，而错过医疗预约不是我想发生的事情。

query_text: Make a world clock app for my phone that shows the current time in several cities at once, so I can pick which cities to add from a list and have them all displayed together on one screen. I want each city to show a clear local time and a small note on whether they are ahead or behind my own timezone, because I am always doing quick mental math to figure out if it is a decent hour to call a colleague and I always get it wrong.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个手机版的世界时钟应用，可以同时显示多个城市的当前时间，这样我可以从列表中选择要添加的城市并在一个屏幕上一起显示它们。我希望每个城市显示清晰的本地时间和一个关于他们是比我自己的时区早还是晚的小注记，因为我总在做快速的心算来判断给同事打电话是否是合适的时间，而我总是算错。

query_text: Build a legal deadline tracker app for my phone that lets me enter court dates and filing deadlines for each case, with the case name and a countdown showing how many days are left. I want the app to sort everything by urgency so the most urgent dates show up at the top, and send me a reminder a week before and the day before each deadline, because missing a court date has consequences I really cannot afford.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个手机版的法律截止日期追踪应用，可以输入每个案件的法庭日期和申请截止日期，带着案件名称和显示还剩多少天的倒计时。我希望应用按紧迫性排序所有内容，最紧迫的日期显示在顶部，并在每个截止日期前一周和前一天发送提醒，因为错过法庭日期会有我真的负担不起的后果。

query_text: Make a content publishing calendar app for my phone where I can plan out what I am posting and when, add the platform, topic, and status for each piece of content, and see everything laid out by week or month. I want to be able to update the status on my phone the moment something goes live, and see at a glance what is coming up next so I stop scrambling at the last minute trying to figure out what I am supposed to be working on.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个手机版的内容发布日历应用，可以规划我要发布什么内容和何时发布，为每段内容添加平台、主题和状态，并按周或月查看所有内容的布局。我想要在东西上线的一刹那就能从手机更新状态，并一目了然地看到接下来发生什么，这样我就不会在最后一刻慌张地琢磨我应该在做什么。

corpus_topic: Grant spending and budget compliance report
query_text: Build a grant spending and budget compliance report tool for my phone that pulls together all the key numbers I always have to chase down manually, like how much of each grant has been spent, what percentage is left, and whether we are still on track with the approved budget categories, so I can just tap through each grant and see the status right away instead of digging through spreadsheets before every review meeting.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个手机版的拨款支出和预算合规报告工具，汇集所有关键数字，这些数字我总是需要手动追踪，比如每个拨款花了多少、剩余百分比多少，以及我们是否仍在批准的预算类别的轨道上。这样我可以轻点查看每个拨款的状态，而不是每次审查会议前都要翻阅电子表格。

query_text: A mobile tracker for patient outcomes and clinic numbers that stops me from having to flip between three different files every time my supervisor asks for an update, showing things like appointment completion rates, how many patients hit their treatment goals this month, and any cases flagged as overdue, all in one place on my phone so I can pull it up fast without juggling a laptop.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个手机版的患者结果和诊所数字追踪工具，可以阻止我每次主管要求更新时在三个不同的文件间来回切换，显示预约完成率、有多少患者本月达到治疗目标、以及任何被标记为逾期的案例，所有内容在我的手机上一个地方，这样我可以快速拉起而无需在笔记本电脑上忙乱。

query_text: Need a sales KPI performance tracker for my phone that saves me from manually tallying up numbers every week before the team meeting, showing each rep's monthly target, how much they have actually closed, and whether they are ahead or behind, with a simple way to filter by person or time period so I can answer follow-up questions on the spot.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个手机版的销售KPI绩效追踪应用，让我不用每周在团队会议前手动统计数字，显示每个代表的月度目标、他们实际成交了多少、以及他们是提前还是落后，并有简单的方式按人员或时间周期筛选，这样我可以当场回答后续问题。

query_text: Need a marketing campaign ROI tracker app for my phone that takes away the pain of building the same report from scratch every time the team asks how a campaign performed, letting me log spend and results for each campaign and see at a glance which ones actually paid off, with a simple comparison so I can stop wasting time doing the math by hand.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个手机版的营销活动投资回报率追踪应用，省去每次团队问活动表现如何时从头构建同一个报告的麻烦，让我为每个活动记录支出和结果，并一目了然地看到哪些活动真的有回报，有一个简单的对比这样我就不用手工做数学计算了。

query_text: Make a personal finance spending breakdown app for my phone that finally shows me exactly where my money goes each month without me having to do the adding up myself, with spending sorted into clear everyday buckets like food, transport, and subscriptions, plus a simple progress bar so I can see how close I am to my monthly limit for each one before I overspend again.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个手机版的个人财务支出分解应用，最终能精确显示我每月的钱花到哪里，无需我自己做加法，支出分为清晰的日常分类如食物、交通和订阅，加上简单的进度条这样我可以在再次超支前看到我离每一个的月度限额有多近。

query_text: Build a team velocity and burndown chart tracker as a mobile app so I can stop updating a spreadsheet every sprint and just enter what got done each day from my phone, with a clean line showing how the remaining work is going down over the sprint and a quick indicator of whether we are on track to finish, because right now I have no easy way to check progress without opening a computer.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个手机版的团队速度和燃尽图表追踪应用，这样我可以停止每个冲刺都更新电子表格，只需从我的手机输入每天完成的工作，有一个干净的线显示冲刺期间剩余工作如何减少，以及我们是否按计划完成的快速指示，因为现在我没有简单的方式来检查进度而不打开计算机。

query_text: Need a social media engagement metrics tracker app on my phone that cuts out all the tab-switching I do every time I want to know how posts are performing, letting me log likes, comments, shares, and follower changes for each platform in one spot, with a simple week-over-week comparison so I can tell whether things are going up or down without building a new chart every time.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个手机版的社交媒体参与度指标追踪应用，消除每次想知道帖子如何表现时进行的所有标签切换，让我在一个地方为每个平台记录点赞、评论、分享和粉丝变化，有一个简单的周对周对比这样我可以知道事物是上升还是下降而无需每次构建新图表。

query_text: Build a mobile app for tracking the e-commerce revenue funnel so I can see at a tap how many people visited the store, how many added something to their cart, how many actually checked out, and what the final revenue looks like, because right now I have to log into three different places to piece that together and it takes forever every time someone asks me for a quick update.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个手机版的电子商务收入漏斗追踪应用，轻点就能看到有多少人访问了商店、有多少人添加了东西到购物车、有多少人实际结账，以及最终的收入是什么样的。因为现在我不得不登录三个不同的地方来拼凑这些信息，每当有人要求快速更新时都要花很长时间。

query_text: Build a mobile HR headcount and attrition tracker that saves me the hassle of manually counting rows in a spreadsheet every time someone asks how many people we have and how many left this quarter, showing total headcount by team, new hires this month, and people who left, with a simple way to tap into each department and see the numbers without having to open a laptop.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个手机版的人力资源员工总数和流失率追踪应用，这样可以省去每次有人问我们有多少人以及这个季度有多少人离职时手动数电子表格行的麻烦。显示按团队的总员工数、本月新员工、以及离职人员，有一个简单的方式轻点进入每个部门查看数字而无需打开笔记本。

query_text: A vitals overview app for my phone that pulls together all my key health numbers in one tidy spot, showing things like heart rate, blood pressure, blood sugar, and weight in a simple list I can scan at a glance, with the most recent reading and the date it was recorded, plus a small note area under each one so I can add any context my doctor might want.

query_text: Make a mental health weekly score tracker as a mobile app where I can rate how I am feeling each day on a simple scale, see a weekly summary that shows my average mood score for the week, and keep a short note for any day where something specific affected my mood, so I can bring a clear picture to my therapist each session.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个心理健康周度评分追踪应用，每天用简单的评分表达我的感受，看到当周的汇总显示周度平均心情评分，还能为有特殊原因影响心情的日子记个短笔记，这样我能为治疗师带去清晰的信息。

query_text: Need a nutrition macro balance summary app on my phone that lets me log my meals and automatically tallies up my daily protein, carbs, and fat, shows a simple breakdown for the day so I can see if I am hitting my targets, and keeps a weekly summary so I can spot patterns in how balanced my eating has been across the whole week.
query_text_zh: 给我做一个营养宏量平衡汇总应用，让我记录各餐食物，应用自动统计每天的蛋白质、碳水和脂肪，显示简单的日度分解让我看能否达到目标，还能看到周度汇总，这样我就能发现整周的饮食平衡规律。

query_text: Build a fertility cycle status overview app for my phone that tracks my cycle length, lets me log my basal body temperature and symptoms each day, shows a clear calendar view of where I am in my current cycle, and highlights the days that look most fertile based on the data I have entered so far.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个生育周期状态概览应用，追踪我的周期长度，每天记录基础体温和症状，显示清晰的日历视图告诉我现在在周期的哪个阶段，根据输入的数据高亮显示最易孕的日子。

query_text: Create a mobile app for tracking my athletic performance over time, where I can log each workout with the activity type, distance or duration, and how hard it felt, then see a simple graph showing my progress week by week, plus a personal best section that highlights my top numbers for each activity so I can watch myself improve.
query_text_zh: 给我做一个运动表现追踪应用，记录每次训练包括活动类型、距离或时长和主观强度感受，然后看到周度进度的简单图表，还有个人最佳部分突显每项运动的最好成绩，这样我就能看到自己在进步。

query_text: Make a chronic condition management app for my phone that lets me keep tabs on multiple ongoing health conditions at once, log daily symptoms and medication taken for each one, and see a clear summary per condition showing how things have been trending this week compared to last week, so I have something organized to review with my doctor.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个慢性病管理应用，能同时追踪多个长期健康问题，每天记录每个问题的症状和用的药物，显示清晰的问题汇总表明这周比上周如何变化，这样我就能有组织地和医生复诊。

query_text: Create a post-COVID recovery progress tracker for my phone that lets me log daily symptoms like fatigue, brain fog, and breathlessness on a simple scale, track my energy level and how many steps I managed each day, and show a weekly progress chart so I can see whether things are slowly getting better over time and share it with my doctor.
query_text_zh: 给我做一个新冠后恢复进度追踪应用，每天用简单的评分表记录疲劳、脑雾和呼吸困难等症状，追踪每天的精力和步数，显示周度进度图表让我看到事情是否在慢慢好转，还能与医生分享。

query_text: Make a mobile app for tracking an elderly parent's daily health, where I can log their meals, medications, blood pressure readings, and mood each day in one place, see a clean daily summary at the top, and have a history list so I can quickly flip back and compare how they were doing earlier in the week or last week.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个追踪年迈父母日常健康的应用，我能在一个地方记录他们每天的进食、用药、血压读数和心情，显示一个干净的日度汇总在顶部，还有历史列表可以快速回顾他们本周或上周的状况。

query_text: Create a grief and loss compassion meditation app for my phone with a soft, muted color palette, gentle typography, and a quiet atmosphere that feels like a safe space rather than a wellness product, where each session guides you through acknowledging the pain of loss with warm narrated prompts, and the overall tone is unhurried and deeply tender.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个悲伤和损失同情冥想应用，用柔和、静音的色彩、温和的字体和安静的氛围，感觉像一个安全的地方而不是商业产品，每个练习用温暖的叙述引导我承认失去的痛苦，整体基调是不匆忙和温柔体贴。

query_text: Need a postpartum relaxation breathing guide for my phone that feels warm and nurturing rather than clinical, with a gentle visual that expands and contracts to pace your breath, soft pastel tones that feel calming, and short encouraging words timed to each inhale and exhale so a new mom can decompress in just a few quiet minutes.
query_text_zh: 给我做一个产后放松呼吸指导应用，感觉温暖和育养而不是冰冷专业，有一个温和的视觉效果会随呼吸扩张和收缩，柔和的粉彩色调令人平静，还有短的鼓励语和每次吸气呼气同步，这样新妈妈就能在几分钟的安静中放松。

query_text: Need a 4-7-8 breathing timer for my phone that feels like a calm ritual rather than a stopwatch, with a beautiful animated visual that blooms open on the inhale and softly closes on the exhale, a muted earthy color story that instantly soothes, and a gentle chime marking each phase so you can do the whole cycle with your eyes half-closed.
query_text_zh: 我需要一个4-7-8呼吸计时器，感觉像一个平静的仪式而不是秒表，有一个漂亮的动画视觉效果在吸气时绽放，呼气时温柔地闭合，静音的土色调令人舒缓，温和的提示音标记每个阶段，这样我就能睁着半睁的眼睛完成整个周期。

query_text: Make a box breathing stress reset guide as a mobile app where the whole visual experience feels like slowing down, with a quietly animated square that traces the four equal phases in a way that feels almost meditative to watch, cool neutral tones that feel like taking a deep breath just by looking at the screen, and a simple count visible during each phase.
query_text_zh: 做一个方形呼吸压力重置指导应用，整个视觉体验感觉像在放慢速度，有一个安静的动画正方形追踪四个等长的阶段，看起来几乎是冥想的，冷静的中性色调看起来就像深呼吸，每个阶段都有简单的计数显示。

query_text: Need a loving-kindness meditation app on my phone where the whole experience feels like being wrapped in warmth, the screen uses soft golds and creams that feel genuinely inviting, each step of the script appears one gentle phrase at a time, and the pacing gives you a real moment to sit with each wish before the next one arrives.
query_text_zh: 我想要一个慈爱冥想应用，整个体验感觉像被温暖包围，屏幕用柔和的金色和奶油色令人真正邀请，每一步的脚本一次出现一个温和的短语，节奏给我真实的时间在每个祝福到来前坐着。

query_text: Make a sleep meditation narration series as a mobile-first app that feels like someone dimmed the lights for you, with a dark dreamy visual, hushed typography, and a series of narrated sessions you can choose by mood or length, where each one eases you in slowly with a calming soundscape playing softly underneath the voice.

query_text: Build a pre-exam focus breathing calm app for my phone that looks clean and focused but still feels reassuring, with a single breathing animation front and center, a color palette of clear soft blues that feel sharp but not cold, and a short guided intro that sets the right mental tone before you tap to start the breathing cycle.

query_text: Need a grief processing gentle meditation app on my phone that feels genuinely unhurried and compassionate, with a soft natural color palette of muted greens and creams, slow flowing transitions between each guided moment, and narration that speaks to you like a kind friend rather than a wellness coach, giving you space to feel whatever comes up.

query_text: Build a nature soundscape ambient session player for my phone that feels immersive and beautifully designed, with lush illustrations that shift between forest, rain, and ocean scenes matching the selected sound, a dim minimal layout that keeps the visual distraction low, and a simple timer so you can set a session length and just let the sounds wash over you.

query_text: Make an anger release breathwork guide as a mobile app with a bold visual energy that matches the intensity of the practice, using deep warm tones like burnt orange and charcoal that feel strong rather than soft, a rhythm-driven animation that pulses with each powerful exhale, and short prompts between rounds that help you release tension and come back to calm.

query_text: A travel health advisory tool for my phone where I can type in a destination and get a clear list of health-related things to know before I go, like recommended vaccinations, any current disease alerts, food and water safety tips, and whether I need travel insurance for medical coverage, all organized neatly so I can tick through the list before I pack.

query_text: Make a travel safety score and advisory mobile app where I can type in any destination and instantly see a safety rating for that place along with a short list of current advisories, things to be aware of in specific neighborhoods, and any emergency contact numbers I should save, so I always feel informed and prepared before and during the trip.

query_text: Make a budget backpacker route builder app for my phone where I can add cities and see the total estimated travel cost as I go, with a running tally that updates each time I add a new leg. query_text: Build a family road trip planner app for mobile that lays out the whole journey day by day, so each day has its own screen with the driving route, planned stops, and a place to jot down activities for the kids. query_text_zh: 需要一个手机阅读应用让我能把整篇文章当礼物分享给朋友，他们能读到整个内容即使在付费墙后面，分享体验感觉像传递你喜欢的东西而不仅仅是复制链接，有个漂亮的展示屏显示文章标题和我能写的个性化留言。

corpus_l2_key: ② 文章详情/阅读模式
query_text: Make a mobile news reader app that has a print-friendly layout option, where when I tap to print an article it reformats everything beautifully for paper, with clean typography, no navigation clutter, and the byline and publication date presented in a classic editorial style that looks great whether I am printing from my phone or just previewing it.
query_text_zh: 做一个手机新闻阅读应用，有打印友好的布局选项，当我点击打印一篇文章时它为纸张重新格式化，干净的排版、没有导航混乱、署名和发表日期用经典编辑风格呈现，无论我是从手机打印还是预览都很好看。

query_text: Build a subscription manager app for your phone where all the newsletters and news channels you follow stay perfectly in sync no matter what device you open it on, so if you add a new source on your laptop it shows up right away on mobile too, with a simple list view of everything you are subscribed to and a clear indicator showing when each one last synced.
query_text_zh: 做一个手机订阅管理应用，你关注的所有新闻通讯和新闻频道在任何设备上都完美同步，在笔记本加的新源立即在手机也会显示，简单的列表视图显示你订阅的一切还有清晰的最后同步时间。

corpus_topic: Language and region filter for sources
query_text: Need a news source manager app for my phone that lets me filter everything by language and region so I only see sources from the countries and languages I actually care about, with a straightforward picker where I can select a few languages and a handful of regions, and the app remembers my choices and applies them every time I open it.
query_text_zh: 需要一个手机新闻源管理应用让我按语言和地区筛选这样只看我在乎的国家和语言的来源，有个直接的选择器让我选几种语言和几个地区，应用记住我的选择每次打开都应用。

query_text: A shared reading list app for mobile where you and a few friends can all add articles to the same collection and see what everyone else has saved, with each item showing who added it and a little space to leave a short note, so the whole group can read the same things and come back to discuss them, and each person can check off what they have read.
query_text_zh: 一个手机共享阅读列表应用，你和几个朋友都能把文章加到同一个集合看彼此保存的东西，每项显示谁加的还有短留言空间，整个小组能读同样的东西回头讨论，每个人能标记自己读过的。

query_text: Need a subscriber tracker app for my phone where I can see how my channel or newsletter is growing over time, with a simple chart showing new subscribers each week and a running total at the top, plus a quick glance at which posts or issues brought in the most new followers, so I know what is actually working.
query_text_zh: 需要一个手机订阅追踪应用让我看到自己的频道或新闻通讯如何随时间增长，简单的图表显示每周新增订阅者和顶部的总数，还能快速看到哪些帖子或期刊带来最多新粉丝，这样我知道什么真的有效。

query_text: Build a news feed tuner app for mobile where I can tell the app what kinds of stories I want to see more or less of, using plain sliders or on/off switches for different topics like sports, politics, tech, and local news, so the feed actually reflects what I care about instead of just guessing, and I can adjust it any time.
query_text_zh: 做一个手机新闻源调节应用让我告诉应用想多看或少看什么故事，用滑块或开关切换不同话题比如体育、政治、科技和本地新闻，这样信息流真的反映我的关注而不是瞎猜，任何时候都能调整。

corpus_topic: Quiet hours do-not-disturb for news alerts
query_text: Build a news alert manager app for my phone that lets me set quiet hours so I stop getting pinged during times I have chosen, like late at night or early in the morning, with a simple schedule where I pick a start time and end time for each day of the week, and all news notifications are held until my quiet period ends.
query_text_zh: 做一个手机新闻提醒管理应用让我设置免打扰时段这样我在选定的时间段比如深夜或清晨不会被打扰，简单的时间表让我选择每天的开始和结束时间，所有新闻通知都会暂停直到免打扰时段结束。

query_text: Need a news finder app for my phone with a quick toggle that lets me show only exclusive investigations and in-depth reporting, so when I am tired of regular headlines I can flip one switch and instantly see only the serious long-form pieces, without having to dig through filters or mess with complicated settings every single time.
query_text_zh: 需要一个手机新闻查找应用有快速切换能只显示独家调查和深度报道，当我厌倦普通新闻时翻一下开关就能秒速看到严肃的长篇文章，不用每次都挖掘过滤器或摆弄复杂设置。

corpus_topic: Search within saved and bookmarked articles
query_text: Need a bookmarks manager app for my phone that actually lets me search through all my saved articles, because right now I save stuff and then can never find it again, so I want a simple search bar at the top that looks through titles and topics of everything I have saved and pulls up the right article right away.
query_text_zh: 需要一个手机书签管理应用让我能搜索所有保存的文章，因为现在我保存了就再也找不到，想要个顶部的简单搜索栏能搜索标题和话题并立即找到对应文章。

query_text: A news alert app for mobile where after I search for any topic I can just tap one button to start getting notifications whenever new stories about that topic come in, so I never have to remember to search again, with a simple list of all my active topic alerts that I can turn on or off individually from one place.
query_text_zh: 一个手机新闻提醒应用，搜索任何话题后我只需点一个按钮就能订阅这个话题的新消息通知，这样我再也不用记得手动搜索，简单的列表显示所有激活的话题提醒我可以逐个关闭。

query_text: A news search app for my phone where I can quickly switch between searching just headlines and searching the full text of articles, because sometimes I want a fast headline match and other times I need to find something buried in the body of a piece, with a simple two-option toggle right above the search results that I can tap to switch between the two modes.
query_text_zh: 一个手机新闻搜索应用，我能快速切换只搜索标题和搜索文章全文，有时我想快速匹配标题有时需要找藏在文章正文里的东西，搜索结果上方有个简单的两选一开关可以切换两种模式。

query_text: Make a news browsing app for my phone that has a filter so I can choose to see only stories that have photos or videos attached, because I find myself much more likely to actually read something when there is a good image or clip with it, and the filter should be easy to toggle on and off right from the main feed without having to go into any settings.
query_text_zh: 做一个手机新闻浏览应用有过滤器让我只看包含照片或视频的故事，因为有好图或视频时我更可能真的去读，过滤器应该能从主信息流轻松开启关闭而不用进设置。

query_text: Create a news reader app for my phone where I can turn on a filter that keeps all the sponsored stories and paid posts out of my feed so I only see actual journalism, with a clear on/off switch I can find easily, and once it is on the feed just shows real articles with no promoted clutter mixed in.
query_text_zh: 做一个手机新闻阅读应用我能开启过滤器把赞助故事和付费推广都排出信息流这样只看真正新闻，有个清晰的开关我能轻松找到，一旦打开信息流就只显示真实文章没有推广混乱。

corpus_topic: Customer review with star rating filter
corpus_l2_key: ① 商品详情/规格选择
query_text: Create a product review reader app for mobile that lets me filter customer reviews by star rating so I can choose to see only 3-star and below when I want honest feedback, with a simple row of star buttons at the top of the reviews section that highlights which rating I have selected and instantly updates the list below to show only matching reviews.
query_text_zh: 做一个手机产品评价阅读应用让我按星级筛选评价这样我可以选择只看3星及以下得到诚实反馈，顶部有个简单的星级按钮行突出我选的星级并立即更新下方列表只显示匹配的评价。

corpus_topic: Q&A section with seller response thread
corpus_l2_key: ① 商品详情/规格选择
query_text: Make a product Q and A app for my phone where shoppers can post questions and the seller can reply right underneath each one, so the whole conversation is easy to follow, with the most recent unanswered questions shown first and a way to search through existing questions before posting a new one so people stop asking the same thing over and over.
query_text_zh: 做一个手机产品问答应用购物者可以提问卖家在下方回复，整个对话易于跟踪，最新未回答的问题显示在前面，还能在发新问题前搜索已有问题这样人们不会重复提问。

query_text: Build a shopping cart app for my phone where each item in the cart shows its own estimated delivery date right there in the list, so I can see at a glance that the shoes will arrive Thursday but the book might take until next week, and I do not have to tap into each item separately just to figure out when things are coming.
query_text_zh: 做一个手机购物车应用每件商品都显示估计送达日期直接在列表里，这样我能一眼看到鞋子周四到但书可能要到下周，不用点击每件商品才能知道什么时候到。

query_text: Make a mobile checkout app where when I have items going to different addresses, like one to my home and another to my parents, I can split the delivery so each item goes to the right place and I can confirm both addresses separately before paying, all handled on one clear checkout screen on my phone without making me place two separate orders.
query_text_zh: 做一个手机结账应用，当我有多件商品要送到不同地址比如一件去我家一件去父母家时，我能分开配送让每件都去对的地方并分别确认两个地址，都在一个清晰的手机结账屏上处理而不用下两个订单。

query_text: Build a package tracking app for my phone that lets me reroute an incoming delivery to a nearby parcel locker if I know I will not be home, with a simple option to pick a locker from a short list of nearby ones, confirm the change, and then track the updated delivery right from the same app without having to call anyone or jump to another service.
query_text_zh: 做一个手机包裹追踪应用让我能改变收货地址到附近的快递柜如果我知道自己不在家，简单地从列表选一个附近的柜子、确认改变然后在同一个应用里追踪更新后的配送而不用打电话或跳到其他服务。

corpus_topic: Return request with label print flow
query_text: A returns manager app for my phone where I can start a return on any order, pick a reason, and then get a return label sent right to my phone that I can either print at home or show as a QR code at a drop-off point, so the whole return is handled in a few taps and I always know the status of my refund afterward.
query_text_zh: 一个手机退货管理应用我能在任何订单发起退货、选择原因然后退货标签直接发到手机上，我可以在家打印或在取件点显示二维码，整个退货过程几次点击完成且我总能知道退款状态。
